title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
english: Russian drone strikes have targeted major bridges in Kyiv for four days in a row, causing injuries and significant traffic disruptions for the city's residents. These attacks on vital infrastructure coincided with a surprise visit from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who traveled to the capital to demonstrate his support for Ukraine. Local officials are working to repair the damage and explore alternative transportation methods to keep the city connected despite the ongoing military pressure.
amharic: የሩሲያ ድሮኖች ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት በኪየቭ ዋና ዋና ድልድዮች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ጉዳት ያደረሱ ሲሆን በከተማዋ የትራፊክ መጨናነቅ እንዲፈጠር አድርገዋል። እነዚህ ወሳኝ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች የጀርመን ቻንስለር ፍሬድሪች ሜርዝ ድጋፋቸውን ለመግለጽ ባደረጉት ድንገተኛ ጉብኝት ወቅት ነው የተከሰቱት። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ድልድዮች ለመጠገን እና ህዝቡን ለማገናኘት አማራጭ የመጓጓዣ መንገዶችን ለመዘርጋት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa guyyoota afur walitti aansuun buufataalee gurguddaa magaalaa Kiyiv irratti haleellaa drooniin raawwateen namoonni miidhamanii fi tajaajilli geejjibaas gufatee jira. Haleellaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa kanaa irratti raawwatame kun, kan mudate yeroo kansoolariin Jarman Fireediriik Meerz deeggarsa isaanii ibsuuf gara magaalaattishee taa'itti daawwannaa tasaa taasisanitti dha. Bulchiinsi magaalaas miidhaa qaqqabe suphuu fi namoota nagaaf tajaajila geejjibaa bakka bu'uuf karoorfataa jiru.

title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
english: Australian authorities are investigating the background of an Omani co-pilot who attacked his captain with an axe during a Flydubai flight to Israel. The pilot was able to regain control with the help of passengers, and the plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Officials are now examining the suspect’s previous time studying in Australia to determine if he was radicalized while living in the country.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ባለሥልጣናት ከዱባይ ወደ እስራኤል በሚበር አውሮፕላን ላይ ካፒቴኑን በመጥረቢያ ያጠቃውን የኦማን ተወላጅ ረዳት አብራሪ ዳራ እያጣሩ ነው። ተሳፋሪዎች በተረባረቡበት ወቅት አውሮፕላኑ በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሰላም ማረፍ ችሏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ጥርጣሬ ያለበት ግለሰብ በአውስትራሊያ ቆይታው ወቅት አክራሪነት ውስጥ ገብቶ እንደነበር ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa qondaala balaliisaa biyya Omaan kan ta'e fi balaliii Dubaayii gara Israa'elitti imala turerratti kapteena isaa qottoon haleele sana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Imaltoonni birmannaa gochuun ajajichi gara Sa'udii Arabiyaatti nagaadhaan akka qubatu taasisaniiru. Qondaalonni mootummaa shakkamaan kun yeroo Awustiraaliyaa keessa barataa turetti yaada hammeenyaa qabatee akka ture qorachaa jiru.

title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge as Germany’s Merz visits Ukraine’s capital
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv to reaffirm Germany's commitment to Ukraine, despite ongoing Russian missile and drone attacks on the city. During his trip, Russia struck a major bridge in the capital, highlighting the volatile security situation. The visit focused on strengthening defense cooperation, including plans for joint weapon manufacturing and the announcement of a new military and energy aid package.
amharic: የጀርመኑ ቻንስለር ፍሬድሪክ ሜርዝ በዩክሬን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሩሲያ ጥቃት በመቋቋም የጀርመንን ድጋፍ ለማረጋገጥ ወደ ኪየቭ ተጉዘዋል። የጉብኝቱ ወቅት ሩሲያ በከተማዋ በሚገኝ ዋና ድልድይ ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘረችበት ቢሆንም፣ መሪዎቹ በጋራ የጦር መሳሪያ ምርት እና በአዲስ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ጥቅል ላይ ተወያይተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት ለዩክሬን የተሰጠው አዲስ የጦር እና የኢነርጂ ዘርፍ ድጋፍ ይፋ የተደረገበትም ጭምር ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Jarman Friedrich Merz, weerara Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyev irratti geggeessaa jirtu keessa iyyuu deggarsa biyyi isaanii qabdu ibsuuf gara magaalaatti imalaniiru. Imala isaanii kana keessa Raashiyaan daandii gurguddaa magaalaa Kiyev keessaa tokko kan ta'e riqicha irratti haleellaa geggeessiteerti. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala waldoota waraanaa cimsuu fi deggarsa lolaa fi anniisaa haaraa biyyi Jarman qopheessite irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Brazil votes in deeply polarised election pitting Lula against Bolsonaro
english: Brazil is holding a highly competitive presidential election featuring current leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva against Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of the former president. The race focuses on contrasting visions for the country, with voters primarily concerned about issues like crime, corruption, and the rising cost of living. If no candidate secures an outright majority today, a final runoff vote will be held on October 25.

oromo: Brazil Prezidaantii amma jiru Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi ilma prezidaantii duraanii Flavio Bolsonaro gidduutti filannoo cimaa gaggeeffachaa jirti. Filannoon kun mul'ata biyyattii irratti yaada adda addaa qabu, akkuma ta'es lammiileen biyyattii dhimmoota akka yakka, malaammaltumma fi gatii jireenyaa dabaluu irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru. Yoo kanneen dorgoman keessaa tokkollee sagalee walakkaa ol argachuu baate, filannoon lammaffaan Onkololeessa 25 ni gaggeeffama.

title: Iran says Hormuz to remain closed until US meets conditions
english: Iran has announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain blocked until the United States agrees to a seven-point proposal for reopening the waterway. Iranian officials stated that they are prepared to defend themselves if the U.S. pursues military action while continuing to push for diplomatic terms. President Trump has previously rejected Iran's conditions, leading to ongoing tensions regarding the crucial maritime oil route.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያን ለመክፈት ያቀረበችው ሰባት ነጥብ ያካተተ እቅድ በአሜሪካ እስኪቀበል ድረስ መተላለፊያው ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቃለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት አሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የምትወስድ ከሆነ ራሳቸውን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸው፣ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መፍትሄ ለማግኘትም ጥረት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ቀደም ሲል የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ውድቅ ማድረጋቸው፣ በነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ቁልፍ መስመር ላይ ያለው ውጥረት እንዲቀጥል አድርጓል።
oromo: Iraan, karaa bishaan garba Hormuz banuuf fedhii ishee qabdu guutuu fi dhimmi kun hamma Ameerikaan fudhatamutti karaichi cufaa ta'ee akka turu beeksisteetti. Qondaalonni Iraan Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhattee yoo dhufe of irraa ittisuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru; gama biraanis karaa dippiloomaasiin rakkoo kana furuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru. Preezidaant Traamp duraan haala Iraan dhiyeessite waan didaniif, dhimmi karaa bishaan kanaa irratti walitti bu'iinsi ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Ethiopian government forces seize Tigray capital Mekelle as TPLF withdraws
english: Ethiopian government forces and their allies have taken control of Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray region, following the withdrawal of TPLF fighters. The TPLF stated they left the city strategically to relocate their operations after federal troops captured the local airport. This escalation follows the breakdown of a 2022 peace agreement, sparking international concern about regional stability.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ሰራዊት እና አጋሮቹ የህወሓት ታጣቂዎች በመውጣታቸው የትግራይ ክልል ዋና ከተማ የሆነችውን መቀሌን መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የህወሓት አመራር ሰራዊቱን ከከተማዋ ያስወጣው ስልታዊ በሆነ መልኩ ሌላ ቦታ ለመስራት መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ አዲስ ግጭት እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተደረሰው የሰላም ስምምነት መፍረስን ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ላይ ስለሚኖረው የፀጥታ ስጋት አለም አቀፍ ስጋቶችን ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Itoophiyaa fi deggartoonni isaanii, hidhattoonni TPLF magaalaa Maqaleedhaa gadhiisanii erga ba'anii booda toannaa isaanii jala oolchaniiru. TPLF akka jedhetti, humnoonni isaanii bakka biraa irraa duula isaanii itti fufuuf jecha malaan magaalamtitti gadhiisanii bahan. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan dhalate waliigaltee nagaa bara 2022 cabuu hordofee yoo ta'u, kunis naannichatti tasgabbii dhabamuuf soda guddaa uumeera.

title: Red Bull’s Verstappen wins rain-delayed Bahrain GP F1 race in Sepang
english: Max Verstappen secured his first Formula One victory of the season at the Bahrain Grand Prix, which was held in Malaysia following a significant weather delay. Despite a difficult start on wet tracks, Verstappen regained the lead after a safety car period and maintained it to finish ahead of Kimi Antonelli and Lewis Hamilton. The race location was moved to Sepang due to international security concerns affecting the global sports schedule.

Jalqaba irratti haala qilleensa hamaa keessa darbus, erga konkolaataan nageenyaa seenanii booda dursi isaa kabajamee Kimii Antoneelii fi Luwiis Haamiltonin dhiisee injifachuu danda'eera. Bakki dorgommichaa kan jijjiirame sababa yaaddoo nageenya addunyaatiin wal qabatee dha.

title: Yemeni government to launch military campaign to reclaim Houthi-controlled territory
english: The Yemeni government has officially announced plans to begin a military campaign aimed at regaining areas currently held by Houthi forces. President Rashad al-Alimi stated that the operation seeks to restore state authority and control over the nation's remaining territories. This move marks a significant effort by the leadership council to reclaim lands that have been under rebel control.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁጥጥር ስር ያሉ ግዛቶችን ለማስመለስ የሚያስችል ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ለመጀመር መዘጋጀቱን አስታውቋል። የፕሬዚዳንታዊ አመራር ምክር ቤት ሰብሳቢ ረሻድ አል-አሊሚ እንደገለጹት፣ ዘመቻው የመንግስትን ስልጣን እና ተቋማት በአገሪቱ በሙሉ ለማስከበር ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ መንግስት ከሁቲዎች ቁጥጥር ስር ያሉ ቀሪ መሬቶችን ለመረከብ የሚያደርገው ከፍተኛ ጥረት አካል ነው።

Akkaataan kunis qe'ee harka finxaaleyyii jiran humnaan deebisanii fudhachuuf yaalii godhamu dha.

title: As olive harvest nears, Palestinian farmers urgently need international protection
english: As the olive harvest season approaches in the West Bank, Palestinian farmers face unprecedented levels of violence from armed settlers and military restrictions. These agricultural workers are being targeted by attacks that hinder their ability to access ancestral lands, which are vital for their economic survival. International intervention is urgently requested, as these incidents are described as state-sanctioned efforts to drive Palestinians from their land through systematic intimidation.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የወይራ ምርት ወቅት እየቀረበ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት የፍልስጤም አርሶ አደሮች በታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደራዊ እገዳዎች የተነሳ ከባድ የጥቃት ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። እነዚህ አርሶ አደሮች ለኑሯቸው ወሳኝ የሆነውን የጥንት የወይራ እርሻቸውን እንዳያለሙ ጥቃቶች እና መሰናክሎች እየደረሱባቸው ይገኛል። ጥቃቶቹ በመንግስት ድጋፍ የሚፈጸሙ እና ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመሬታቸው ለማፈናቀል ያለሙ መሆናቸው በመገለጹ፣ አለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰቡ አስቸኳይ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንዲያደርግ እየተጠየቀ ነው።
oromo: Yeroon buqqifannaa ejersaa naannoo West Bankitti dhihaachaa yoo ta'u, qonnaan bultoonni Palastayinii miidhaa fi doorsisa humnoota qawwii qabanii fi kanneen qubattootaa irraa gahuufi saaxilamaniiru. Hojiin qonnaa kun jiraachuu isaaniif bu'uura kan ta'e yoo ta'u, miidhaan irra gahu kunis midhaan isaanii akka hin sassaabbanne dhorkaa jira. Haleellaan kun kan mootummaan deeggaramu fi Palastayinii lafa isaanii irraa arii'uuf kan karoorfame ta'uu ibsamee, hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa akka fudhatu gaafatamaa jira.

title: Israeli air strikes target southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted airstrikes in two locations within southern Lebanon, specifically targeting the Wadi al-Hujair region and areas near the town of Kfar Tebnit. As of now, there is no official information regarding injuries or deaths resulting from these operations. Authorities are continuing to monitor the situation following the reported explosions.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ ሁለት አካባቢዎች ማለትም በዋዲ አል-ሁጃይር እና በክፋር ተብኒት ከተማ ዳርቻዎች ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ፈጽመዋል። በነዚህ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም። ሁኔታው በክትትል ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoositti bakka lamatti, kanneenis naannoo Waadii al-Hujayir fi qarqara magaalaa Kfar Tebniitirratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kana hordofee miidhaan namarra ga'e ykn lubbuun darbe hanga ammatti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, haalli jiru hordofamaa jira.

title: Houthis cut vital supply road to Yemen's Taiz
english: Houthi forces have seized control of a key area in Yemen, effectively blocking the primary supply route between Taiz and the interim capital, Aden. By capturing the al-Safiya region and its local police station, the group has managed to surround the city of Taiz. This development has been confirmed by multiple military and security officials in the region.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የምትገኘውን ታይዝ ከተማን ከጊዜያዊ መዲናዋ አደን ጋር የሚያገናኘውን ዋና የትራንስፖርት መስመር ተቆጣጥረዋል። አል-ሳፊያ የተባለውን አካባቢ እና የፖሊስ ጣቢያ በቁጥጥራቸው ስር በማዋላቸው ታይዝ ከተማ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ተከባለች። ይህንን የሁቲዎች እንቅስቃሴ የየመን ወታደራዊ እና የፀጥታ ምንጮች አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Humni Houthi karaa guddicha magaala Taiz fi magaala guddoo yeroo Adan wal qunnamsiisu to'annoo isaanii jala galchaniiru. Aana al-Safiya fi buufata poolisii bakka sanaa to'annoo isaanii jala oolchuun, magaala Taiz guutummaatti marsuun isaanis mirkanaa'eera. Odeeffannoon kun maddoota waraana fi nageenyaa Yamanitiin kan mirkanaa'e dha.

title: Iran to increase the range of its missiles, army spokesperson tells Fars
english: A top Iranian military official announced that the country plans to extend the reach of its missile systems. This decision follows observations of American military forces stationed within 1,000 kilometers of Iranian borders during ongoing regional tensions. The move is considered a strategic priority for Iran's defense efforts.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን ሀገሪቱ የሚሳኤሎቿን ርቀት ለመጨመር ማቀዷን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አሜሪካ በክልሉ ባላት እንቅስቃሴ ከኢራን የባህር ዳርቻ በ1,000 ኪሎ ሜትር ርቀት ላይ ወታደሮቿን በማሰፈሯ ምክንያት ነው። ኢራን ይህን እርምጃ ለመከላከያ ስልታዊ ስራዋ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Hoggansi waraana Iraan biyyattiin dandeettii fi fageenya misaa'eloota ishee akka dabaltu ibseera. Murtichi kan dhufes humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa daangaa biyyattii irraa hanga kiilomeetira kuma tokko keessatti qubannaa godhachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Iraan tarkaanfiin kun dhimma ittisa biyyaatiif murteessaa ta'uu isaa beeksisiteetti.

title: West Indies beat India in record chase as Hope hits 162 in third ODI
english: West Indies captain Shai Hope scored an unbeaten 162 to lead his team to a historic run-chase victory against India in the third ODI. Despite India setting a challenging target of 351, the West Indies successfully chased it down with five wickets and 10 balls remaining. This win marks the West Indies' highest-ever ODI run chase and their first victory against India since 2023.
amharic: የዌስት ኢንዲስ ካፒቴን ሻይ ሆፕ ባስመዘገበው 162 ነጥብ አማካኝነት ቡድኑ በሦስተኛው የአንድ ቀን ዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ጨዋታ ህንድን ታሪካዊ በሆነ መልኩ ማሸነፍ ችሏል። ህንድ በበኩሏ 351 ነጥብ አስመዝግባ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የዌስት ኢንዲስ ተጫዋቾች ዒላማውን 5 ዊኬቶችን በመጠቀም ከጨዋታው ማለቂያ በፊት ማሳካት ችለዋል። ይህ ድል የዌስት ኢንዲስ በታሪካቸው ከፍተኛውን የነጥብ ዒላማ ተከትለው ያሸነፉበት ሲሆን፣ ከ2023 በኋላ በህንድ ላይ ያገኙት የመጀመሪያ ድልም ሆኗል።
oromo: Kapiteenni garee West Indies Shaay Hoop qabxii 162 kan hin injifatamin galchuun, tapha kriketii guyyaa tokkoo sadaffaa irratti gareen isaa Hindii injifatee seenaa hojjeteera. Hindin qabxii 351 galchitee turee, garuu West Indies wixinee kana 5 wicket qofa fayyadamuun yeroon osoo hin dhumatin injifachuu danda'eera. Injifannoon kun West Indies seenaa isaanii keessatti qabxii baay'ee ol'aanaa ta'e tokko hordofanii injifatan yoo ta'u, bara 2023 booda Hindii irratti injifannoo argatan jalqabaati.

title: Widespread damage after huge hailstones pound Paraguay capital
english: A severe storm hit Paraguay's capital, bringing intense winds, heavy rain, and unusually large hailstones. The powerful ice chunks caused significant property damage, including shattering windows and denting vehicles throughout the city. Local residents are dealing with the aftermath of this destructive weather event.
amharic: ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ፣ ከባድ ዝናብ እና ያልተለመደ ግዙፍ የበረዶ ቅንጣቶች የፓራጓይን ዋና ከተማ በመምታታቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። እነዚህ ግዙፍ የበረዶ ቅንጣቶች የቤት መስኮቶችን በመስበር እና ተሽከርካሪዎችን በመጨፍለቅ ንብረት ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች በዚህ አውዳሚ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት የደረሰውን ጉዳት ለመጠገን እየተሯሯጡ ነው።
oromo: Obomboleettiin cimaan, roobni gurguddaan fi cabbiin akkaan gurguddaan magaalaa guddoo Paaraaguwaay rukutanii miidhaa geessisaniiru. Cabbiin kun iddoowwan hedduutti foddaa manaafi konkolaattota miidhuun qabeenyarratti mancaatii guddaa uumeera. Jiraattonni magaalattii miidhaa haala qilleensa kanaatiin isaan mudate booda rakkoo keessa jiru.

title: Somalia President: Houthis ‘not in a position’ to bring Yemen peace
english: Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has criticized the Houthi movement, arguing they lack the capability to foster peace in Yemen. During an interview, he blamed the group for causing regional instability and endangering maritime traffic in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. The President expressed deep concern over the group's negative impact on security in the area.
amharic: የሶማሊያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሃሰን ሼክ መሃሙድ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ሰላምን ለማምጣት የሚያስችል አቅም እንደሌላቸው ገለጹ። በአንድ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ቡድኑ በክልሉ ውስጥ አለመረጋጋትን በመፍጠር እና በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ዳርቻ የሚደረገውን የባህር ጉዞ አደጋ ላይ በመጣል ተጠያቂ ነው ብለዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የቡድኑ እንቅስቃሴ ለቀጠናው ደህንነት ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Somaaliyaa Hasan Sheek Mohaamud, gareen Huutii Yaman keessatti nagaa buusuuf gahaa akka hin taane dubbatan. Gaaffii fi deebii taasisaniin, gareen kun naannicha keessatti jeequmsa uumuu fi bishaan daangaa Baab al-Mandeb keessatti walitti dhufeenya dooniiwwanii miidhuun yakkan. Pirezidaantichi sochii garee kanaa nagaa naannichaa irratti balaa guddaa akka ta'e ibsan.

title: Bosnia general election 2026 explained in maps and charts
english: On October 4, 2026, over 3.4 million Bosnian voters will participate in general elections to select leadership at multiple government levels. The process introduces new technology, including biometric identification and ballot scanners, to improve the speed and transparency of the vote count. Key contests feature various candidates for the Bosniak, Croat, and Serb seats on the state presidency, representing a variety of political parties and ideologies.
amharic: ጥቅምት 4 ቀን 2026 ከ 3.4 ሚሊዮን በላይ የቦስኒያ መራጮች በተለያዩ የመንግስት እርከኖች ላይ መሪዎቻቸውን ለመምረጥ ወደ ምርጫ ጣቢያዎች ያመራሉ። የምርጫ ሂደቱ ይበልጥ ግልጽ እና ፈጣን እንዲሆን የባዮሜትሪክ መለያዎችን እና የድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀት መቃኛዎችን ጨምሮ አዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ። በምርጫውም ለቦስኒያክ፣ ለክሮኤት እና ለሰርቢያ ብሔረሰብ የፕሬዚዳንትነት መቀመጫ የሚወዳደሩ በርካታ እጩዎች በየፓርቲዎቻቸው ቀርበዋል።
oromo: Onkololeessa 4, 2026 kanatti, lammiileen Bosniyaa miiliyoona 3.4 ol ta'an sadarkaa mootummaa gara garaatti gaggeessitoota isaanii filachuuf sagalee kennuuf qophiirra jiru. Adeemsi filannoo kun haala ammayya'aa fi ifa ta'een akka gaggeeffamuuf, teeknoolojii biyoometirikiifi skaaniin sagalee ittiin lakka'amu hojiirra ooleera. Filannoo kanaan walqabatee, iddoo pirezidaantummaa kanneen akka Bosniyaak, Kro'etii fi Serbiyaaf dorgomtootni paartilee gara garaa bakka bu'an kan hirmaatan ta'a.

title: Saudi-led coalition dismisses Houthi claim of attack on Riyadh
english: The Saudi-led coalition has rejected claims by Houthi rebels that they successfully attacked an oil facility near Riyadh. Officials stated that the rebels are fabricating these reports to distract from their significant military defeats and rising domestic discontent. According to the coalition, these claims are merely attempts to create a sense of false victory while they continue to suffer losses on the battlefield.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት የሁቲ አማፂያን በሪያድ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ መትታችኋል የሚለውን ውንጀላ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ጥምረቱ አማፂያኑ እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ከባድ ወታደራዊ ሽንፈት እና የውስጥ ለውስጥ ተቃውሞ ለመሸፈን ይህን የሐሰት መረጃ እንደፈጠሩ አስታውቋል። የቡድኑ የጦር ሜዳ ኪሳራ ከፍተኛ በመሆኑ፣ የውሸት ድል ለማስመሰል እየሞከሩ እንደሆነም ባለስልጣናቱ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu, gareen Huthuu naannoo Riyaaditti bakka oomisha boba’aa miidheera jedhee gabaase kijiba jechuun haaleera. Jilaan kun, gareen Huthuu injifannoo argachuu isaa sobaan ibsuun, kufaatii waraanaa isa mudate fi mormii ummataa keessoo isaa dhoksuuf yaalii gochaa jiru jedheera. Huthuun bakka garagaraatti injifatamaa waan jiruuf, injifannoo sobaa ummataaf agarsiisuuf jecha oduu kana facaase jedhameera.

title: Israel says 1, 318 personnel killed since 7 Oct Hamas attack
english: The Israeli Ministry of Defense reported that 1,318 personnel have died since the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack. This total encompasses soldiers, police, and various security officials who lost their lives in combat or due to other causes like accidents and illness. The ongoing conflict has significantly impacted families, leaving behind thousands of grieving parents, children, and siblings.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 የሃማስ ጥቃት ወዲህ 1,318 የጸጥታ ኃይሎች መሞታቸውን አስታውቋል። ይህ ቁጥር ወታደሮችን፣ ፖሊሶችን እና ሌሎች የጸጥታ አካላትን በጦርነት ወይም በሌሎች ምክንያቶች የሞቱትን ሁሉ ያጠቃልላል። ይህ ግጭት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦችን ለሀዘን የዳረገ ሲሆን፣ ወላጆች፣ ባለቤቶች፣ ልጆች እና ወንድማማቾች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el akka ibsetti, erga haleellaa Hamaas kan Sadaasa 7, 2023 geggeeffamee as namoonni 1,318 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Lakkoofsi kun loltoota, poolisoota fi hojjettoota nageenyaa waraana ykn sababoota biroon du'an hunda kan qabatuudha. Walitti bu'iinsi kun maatiiwwan kumaan lakkaa'aman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee, warra, ijoollee fi obboloota hedduu gadda cimaa keessa buuseera.

title: Iran opens military centre for citizens, 'training 1,000 battalions'
english: Iran has launched a new military training facility in Tehran to prepare civilians for potential ground conflicts with the United States and Israel. The program aims to train 1,000 battalions using various techniques, including virtual reality and physical obstacle courses. Officials stated that this initiative is a defensive measure to ensure the public is ready to respond to any future hostilities.
amharic: ኢራን ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ሊሰነዘር የሚችልን ጥቃት ለመመከት ዜጎችን የሚያሰለጥን አዲስ የወታደራዊ ስልጠና ማዕከል በቴህራን ከፍታለች። መርሃ ግብሩ በቨርቹዋል ሪያሊቲ እና በተግባራዊ ልምምዶች በመታገዝ አንድ ሺህ ሻለቃዎችን ለማሰልጠን ያለመ ነው። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ህዝቡ ለወደፊት ግጭቶች ዝግጁ እንዲሆን ለማድረግ የተወሰደ የመከላከያ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Iiraan weerara lafa irraa kan Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irraa dhufuu danda'u of irraa ittisuuf jecha, buufata leenjii waraanaa haaraa magaalaa Teheran keessatti banatteetti. Sagantaan kun teeknoolojii ammayyaa fi leenjii qaamaa fayyadamuun loltoota kuma tokko leenjisuuf kan karoorfatedha. Hojiin kun sabni weerara kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf qophii ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf akka kaayyeffate mootummaan beeksiseera.

title: Iran arrests 31 people linked to 'US-Israel sabotage networks', report says
english: Iranian authorities have detained 31 individuals in Kerman province for allegedly running sabotage networks supported by the U.S. and Israel. Officials claim the groups were recruiting young people to create weapons, damage public property, and incite unrest. The government also linked these suspects to violence during recent nationwide protests.
amharic: የኢራን የደህንነት ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ድጋፍ ይደረግላቸው ነበር የተባሉ 31 ግለሰቦችን በከርማን ግዛት በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ወጣቶችን በመመልመል የጦር መሳሪያ በማዘጋጀትና የህዝብ ንብረቶችን በማውደም ሁከት ለመፍጠር ሲሰሩ እንደነበር መንግስት ገልጿል። ግለሰቦቹ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ሀገራዊ ተቃውሞ ወቅት ለተፈጠረው ብጥብጥ ተጠያቂ እንደሆኑም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan namoota 31 ta’an, garjalee saboota Amerikaa fi Israa’el irraa deggarsa argatu jedhaman kutaadhabee Kerman keessatti qabuu isaa beeksise. Qaamoleen kun dargaggoota kakaasuun meeshaalee waraanaa qopheessuu fi qabeenya mootummaa mancaasuun jeequmsa uumuuf yaalanii turan jedhameera. Namoonni kunneen mormii biyyaalessaa darbe keessatti gochaa jeequmsaatiin kan qindaa’an ta’uu isaanii ibsameera.

title: A Broken Accord Sends Ethiopians Fleeing the Front Once More
english: A peace agreement signed four years ago in Pretoria has collapsed, leading to a resurgence of conflict in northern Ethiopia. This renewed violence has forced many families to flee their homes and has caused significant disruptions to essential services and financial systems. The breakdown of the truce marks a distressing return to instability for a region that had been seeking recovery.
amharic: ከአራት ዓመታት በፊት በፕሪቶሪያ የተፈረመው የሰላም ስምምነት በመፍረሱ በሰሜን ኢትዮጵያ ዳግም ግጭት ተቀስቅሷል። ይህ አዲስ የፀጥታ መደፍረስ በርካታ ቤተሰቦችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የፋይናንስ አገልግሎቶች እና የትራንስፖርት መስመሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል። የሰላም ስምምነቱ መበላሸት ሰላምን ሲጠባበቅ የነበረውን አካባቢ እንደገና ወደ አለመረጋጋት ውስጥ ከቶታል።
oromo: waliigalteen nagaa waggaa afur dura biyya Afrikaa Kibbaatti, Pretoria keessatti mallatteeffame diigamuu isaa hordofee, kaaba Itoophiyaatti waraanni deebi’ee ka’eera. Walitti bu’iinsi kun maatiin hedduun qe’ee isaanii irraa akka godaanan kan dirqisiise yoo ta’u, tajaajiloonni bu’uuraa fi sirnoonni baankii akka dhaabatan godheera. Diigamuun walii galtee kanaa, nagaa barbaadaa kan ture naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuu guddaa fideera.

title: IMF to Ethiopia on Opening the Capital Account. Not Yet
english: The International Monetary Fund has clarified that Ethiopia's recent foreign exchange reforms do not include opening the country's capital account. The organization advised that any further liberalization of capital movement should be done cautiously and only when the economy is better prepared to handle associated risks. Currently, the reform program is strictly focused on easing existing current-account restrictions rather than allowing free cross-border capital flows.
amharic: የዓለም የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) በቅርቡ በኢትዮጵያ የተደረገው የውጭ ምንዛሪ ተሃድሶ የካፒታል አካውንትን ለመክፈት ያለመ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቋል። ድርጅቱ አክሎም ወደ ካፒታል ነፃነት የሚደረግ ማንኛውም እንቅስቃሴ በጥንቃቄ እና ሀገሪቱ ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ስጋቶችን መቆጣጠር ስትችል ብቻ መከናወን እንዳለበት አሳስቧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የሪፎርሙ ትኩረት የካፒታል ፍሰትን ከመፍቀድ ይልቅ አሁን ባለው የገንዘብ ዝውውር ላይ ያሉ ገደቦችን ማቃለል ላይ ብቻ ያተኮረ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mallaqa Addunyaa (IMF) foyya'iinsi jijjiirraa maallaqa alaa Itoophiyaa keessatti godhame, 'capital account' biyyattii banuuf kan qophaaye miti jedheera. Dhaabbatichi akka gorsetti, sochii maallaqaafi qabeenyaa gara biyya alaa bilisa gochuun hanga diinagdeen biyyattii balaa isarraa dhufuu danda'u dandamachuu danda'utti yeroo fudhachuu qaba. Ammaaf, hojiin foyya'iinsichaa kan xiyyeeffatu daangaa maallaqa alaa amma jiru hir'isuurratti malee, gadi lhiquu maallaqaa daangaa cehee deemurratti miti.

title: Ethiopian Bets Billions on Cargo as Africa’s Planes Fly Half Empty
english: Despite a recent decline in cargo utilization across the African aviation sector, Ethiopian Airlines has decided to invest heavily in its future fleet. The company has placed an order for eight new Boeing 777-8 freighters as part of its long-term Vision 2040 growth strategy. By becoming the first African airline to acquire these advanced aircraft, the carrier aims to significantly boost its logistics capacity between 2033 and 2035.
amharic: በአፍሪካ የአቪዬሽን ዘርፍ የካርጎ አገልግሎት አጠቃቀም እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ለወደፊት ዕቅዱ ከፍተኛ ኢንቨስትመንት እያደረገ ይገኛል። አየር መንገዱ የቪዥን 2040 ስትራቴጂው አካል አድርጎ ስምንት አዳዲስ የቦይንግ 777-8 የጭነት አውሮፕላኖችን ማዘዙን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ግዢ የመጀመሪያው የአፍሪካ አየር መንገድ የሆነው ኢትዮጵያ፣ በ2033 እና በ2035 መካከል እነዚህን ዘመናዊ አውሮፕላኖች በመረከብ የጭነት አቅሙን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለማሳደግ አቅዷል።
oromo: Damee geejjiba xiyyaaraa Afrikaa keessatti fayyadama imala fe’umsaa gadi bu’aa jiraatus, Ethiopian Airlines fuuldura isaa irratti guddinaaf invastimantii guddaa gochaa jira. Dhaabbatichi karoora isaa 'Vision 2040' keessatti guddina isaa mirkaneessuuf, xiyyaara fe’umsaa haaraa 'Boeing 777-8' saddeet bituuf walii galeera. Xiyyaara kana kan bite dhaabbata Afrikaa jalqabaa ta’uun, xiyyaarota kana bara 2033 hanga 2035 keessatti fudhachuun dandeettii fe’umsaa isaa daran guddisuuf karoorfateera.

title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
english: Cornell University's president, Michael Kotlikoff, recently addressed a disturbing incident involving a student who alleged she was drugged and gang-raped at a fraternity house last year. Following public outcry and a civil lawsuit, the president admitted the university failed to handle the case properly and vowed to improve campus safety and accountability. The university is now under pressure to reform its culture and ensure that future victims of sexual violence are supported with compassion.
amharic: የኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሬዝዳንት ሚካኤል ኮትሊኮፍ፣ ባለፈው ዓመት በአንድ የወንድማማችነት ማህበር ቤት ውስጥ ተማሪዋን አደንዝዘው በቡድን ደፈሩዋት በሚል የቀረበውን ክስ አስመልክቶ መግለጫ ሰጥተዋል። ከህዝብ ተቃውሞ እና ከሲቪል ክስ በኋላ፣ ዩኒቨርሲቲው ጉዳዩን በአግባቡ መያዝ እንዳልቻለ በማመን፣ በቀጣይ የካምፓስ ደህንነትን ለማሻሻል እና ተጠያቂነትን ለማስፈን ቃል ገብተዋል። ተቋሙ አሁን ያለውን የካምፓስ ባህል በመቀየር ለጾታዊ ጥቃት ሰለባዎች ድጋፍ እና አክብሮት ለመስጠት ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yuunivarsiitii Koorneel, Maayikil Kotliikof, barattuun tokko waggaa darbe keessa mana waldaa barattootaa tokko keessatti qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu itti fayyadamuun gareedhaan gafaramee jedhamu irratti ibsa kennaniiru. Falmii uummataa fi himannaa seeraa booda, pireezidaantichi yuunivarsiitiin kun dhimma kana sirriitti hordofuu akka dadhabe hubachiisanii, gara fuulduraatti nageenya kampasii fi itti gaafatamummaa fooyyessuuf waadaa seenaniiru. title: Iran war live: Yemeni forces strike Sanaa as Trump warns Tehran of hard way
english: Military forces supported by Saudi Arabia have launched airstrikes against Sanaa, the capital of Yemen currently held by Houthi rebels, leading to a significant increase in displaced families. Meanwhile, U.S. President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Iran, suggesting that the country must soon choose between a peaceful resolution or facing severe consequences. This escalating situation highlights both the worsening humanitarian crisis in Yemen and rising international tensions surrounding Tehran.
amharic: በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሚደገፉ ኃይሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት የከፈቱ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በርካታ ነዋሪዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። በሌላ በኩል የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን በሰላማዊ መንገድ ወይም በኃይል መፍትሄ የመምረጥ አማራጭ እንዳላት በማስጠንቀቅ ጠንከር ያለ መልእክት አስተላልፈዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በየመን እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እና በቴህራን ዙሪያ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ዓለም አቀፍ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnooti Sa'udii Arabaan deggaraman, magaalaa guddoo Yemen Sanaa kan harka Hutiotaa jirtu irratti weerara qilleensaa kan raawwatan yoo ta'u, kunis namoota hedduu manaa fi qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera. Gama biraan, pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, Iraan karaa nagaa ykn karaa hamaa filachuun ishee dirqama akka ta'e akeekkachiisa cimaa kennaniiru. Haalli kun rakkoo namummaa Yemen keessatti hammaachaa jiruufi dhiibbaa idil-addunyaa Teheran irratti jabaachaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: Air ambulance missing on flight from Bermuda to Boston
english: A Canadian air ambulance carrying six people disappeared while traveling from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday. The Gulfstream jet lost contact near Nantucket after the pilot reported an emergency and experienced a sudden drop in altitude. US Coast Guard crews are currently conducting a search and rescue operation to locate the aircraft.
amharic: ስድስት ሰዎችን የጫነ የካናዳ የአየር አምቡላንስ ከበርሙዳ ወደ ቦስተን እየበረረ ሳለ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በድንገት ጠፋ። አውሮፕላኑ ናንታኬት አቅራቢያ በደረሰበት የቴክኒክ ችግር እና ድንገተኛ የከፍታ መቀነስ ምክንያት የቁጥጥር ግንኙነቱ ተቋርጧል። የአሜሪካ የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂዎች አውሮፕላኑን ለመፈለግ ሰፊ የፍለጋ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራ በመስራት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri ambaalaansii kan Kaanaadaa, namoota jaha fe'ee Bermudaa irraa gara Bostan imalaa ture, guyyaa Dilbataa keessa hatattamaan baduu isaa gabaafame. Xiyyaarri kun erga rakkoo mudatee fi bakka baay'ee gad bu'ee booda naannoo Naantaakeetitti quunnamtii isaa dhabe. Humnoonni eegumsa qarqara galaana Amerikaa xiyyaaricha barbaaduuf hojii oolchuu fi barbaacha bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Pelosi-backed US candidate calls for ‘full arms embargo’ on Israel
english: Connie Chan, a candidate endorsed by Nancy Pelosi for California’s congressional seat, has demanded a complete arms embargo against Israel. During a recent debate, she emphasized her commitment to prioritizing humanitarian aid and stated she would oppose funding for Israeli military equipment like the Iron Dome. Her opponent, Scott Wiener, also expressed strong opposition to Israel's military actions, reflecting growing divisions within the Democratic Party regarding US policy in the Middle East.
amharic: ናንሲ ፔሎሲ ለካሊፎርኒያ የኮንግረስ መቀመጫ የደገፏት እጩ ኮኒ ቻን በእስራኤል ላይ አጠቃላይ የጦር መሳሪያ ማዕቀብ እንዲጣል ጠየቁ። በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ክርክር፣ ሰብአዊ እርዳታን ቅድሚያ እንደሚሰጡና እንደ አይረን ዶም ላሉ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ መሳሪያዎች የሚደረገውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚቃወሙ አስታውቀዋል። ተቀናቃኛቸው ስኮት ዊነርም የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በመቃወም አስተያየት የሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በአሜሪካ ዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ፖሊሲ ዙሪያ ያለውን መከፋፈል ያሳያል።
oromo: Koni Chan, kan Nancy Pelosi bakka buutuu Kaalifoorniyaa akka bakka buutuuf deggeran, Israa'el irratti dhoorkaa meeshaa waraanaa guutuu akka godhamu gaafataniiru. Falmii dhiheenya kana taasifame irratti, gargaarsa namummaa dursuuf waadaa seenuun, deeggarsa maallaqaa meeshaalee waraanaa Israa'el kan akka 'Iron Dome' akka morman ibsaniiru. Falmii isaanii kan ta'an Skot Wiinaris gocha waraana Israa'el akka morman ibsuun, kun immoo siyaasa Ameerikaan Baha Giddugaleessa irratti qabdu irratti garee Dimokiraatawaa keessatti wal-dhabbii uumame agarsiisa.

title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian farmers during olive harvest
english: Israeli settlers and soldiers are actively preventing Palestinian farmers from gathering their olive crops as the harvest season starts. This obstruction poses a significant threat to the livelihoods of over 80,000 families who depend on this agricultural work for their income. Such violent actions and restrictions have sparked serious concerns regarding the safety and economic stability of the affected farming communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች እና ወታደሮች የዘይቱን ምርት ወቅት ሲጀምር የፍልስጤም አርሶ አደሮች ምርታቸውን እንዳይሰበስቡ እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በዘይት ምርት ላይ ለሚተማመኑ ከ80,000 በላይ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች የገቢ ምንጭ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ጥቃት እና ማገጃ የአርሶ አደሮቹን ደህንነት እና የኢኮኖሚ ህልውና አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Falasxiin erga yeroon ramayyoo itti eegalee booda, gandaa fi loltoonni Israa'el omisha isaanii akka hin sassaabanne irra deddeebi'anii dhowwaa jiru. Miidhaan kun maatii 80,000 ol ta'an kanneen ramayyoo irraa galii argatan irratti rakkoo dinagdee guddaa uumeera. Gochiiwwan fi dhiibbaan akkanaa kun nageenyaa fi jireenya qotee bulaa kanaa irratti yaaddoo cimaa uumeera.

title: Fernandes denies Portugal rift, hails Ronaldo after walk out
english: Bruno Fernandes has publicly rejected claims of internal conflict within the Portuguese national team following Cristiano Ronaldo's sudden departure from the training camp. Fernandes clarified that he has communicated with Ronaldo and continues to speak highly of his teammate. Ronaldo left the squad after experiencing tension with the head coach and has promised to share further details about his decision later.
amharic: ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴስ ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ በድንገት ከፖርቹጋል ብሄራዊ ቡድን የስልጠና ካምፕ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ በቡድኑ ውስጥ አለመግባባት መፈጠሩን አስተባብሏል። ፈርናንዴስ ከሮናልዶ ጋር መነጋገሩን በመግለጽ ለቡድን አጋሩ ያለውን አክብሮት ገልጿል። ሮናልዶ ከአሰልጣኙ ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ምክንያት ቡድኑን ለቅቆ የወጣ ሲሆን፣ ለዚህ ውሳኔው የሰጠውን ምክንያቶች በቅርቡ ይፋ እንደሚያደርግ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Bruno Fernandes gargar bahuu garee biyyoolessa Poorchugaal keessatti uumame jedhamee oduun faca’e kana haaleera. Kunis kan ta’e yeroo Cristiano Ronaldo dirree leenjii gadi dhiisee ba’etti. Fernandes hiriyoota isaa wajjin walitti dhufeenyi gaariin akka jiru ibsuun, waa’ee Ronaldoo ni dubbata. Ronaldoo leenjisaa isaa wajjin wal dhabuun isaa kan himame yoo ta’u, sababa itti ba’e yeroo biraa akka ibsu beekameera.

title: Trump ramps up pressure on US Republicans to end US clock switching
english: President Donald Trump is aggressively pushing Senate Republicans to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make Daylight Saving Time permanent and eliminate the need to adjust clocks twice a year. He publicly criticized Senator Tom Cotton for blocking the legislation, even sharing the senator's phone number on social media to encourage public pressure. While the bill has already passed in the House, Cotton remains opposed, citing concerns about the potential impact of darker winter mornings on workers and students.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰዓት አቆጣጠርን በየዓመቱ ሁለት ጊዜ የመቀያየር ልማድን የሚያስቀር ህግ በአስቸኳይ እንዲጸድቅ በሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያደረጉ ነው። ትራምፕ ሴናተር ቶም ኮተን ህጉን በማደናቀፋቸው በይፋ በመተቸት፣ ህዝብ እንዲጫጫንባቸው በማሰብ ስልክ ቁጥራቸውን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለቀዋል። ህጉ ቀደም ብሎ በምክር ቤቱ ቢጸድቅም፣ ሴናተር ኮተን በክረምት ወቅት ጠዋት ጨለማ ስለሚሆን በሰራተኞች እና ተማሪዎች ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል በሚል ይቃወሙታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantichi Doonaald Traamp, walakkaa waggaa hunda sa’aatii jijjiiruu hafee, yeroo sa’aatii tokko qofatti dhaabbiin akka itti fufuuf seera 'Sunshine Protection Act' jedhamu akka raggaasisuuf miseensota seeneetii Rippabilikaanotaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa godhaa jiru. Traamp seeneetar Toom Kootan seera kana gufachiisuu isaanii balaaleffachuun, ummanni akka isaanitti dhiibbaa godhuuf jecha lakkofsa bilbila isaanii miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti ifa godhaniiru. Seerichi mana maree bakka buutotaa keessa darbee kan jiru ta’us, Kootan guyyoota gannaa ganama sa’aatii dukkana ta’uun hojjettootaa fi barattoota irratti rakkoo uuma jechuun mormaa jiru.

title: Funeral held at Gaza church for mother and daughter killed in Gaza strike
english: A funeral service took place at Saint Porphyrius Greek Orthodox Church in Gaza City for a mother and her daughter. They were among five people who lost their lives during an Israeli airstrike that hit their residential building overnight. The community gathered to mourn the victims of this deadly military attack.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኘው የቅዱስ ፖርፊሪየስ ግሪክ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተክርስቲያን አንድ እናት እና ልጃቸው የተጠቁበት የቀብር ስነ ስርዓት ተፈጸመ። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በሌሊት በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ህንጻቸው ላይ በተመታ ጊዜ ህይወታቸውን ካጡ አምስት ሰዎች መካከል ይገኙበታል። የአካባቢው ማህበረሰብም ለሟቾች ሀዘኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaatti kan argamtu mana amantii Ortodoksii Gireekii 'Saint Porphyrius' keessatti sirni awwaalchaa haadha fi intala tokkoof raawwatameera. Namoonni kunneen haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el halkan keessa mana jireenyaa isaanii irratti geggeessiteen lubbuun isaanii darbe keessatti kan argaman yoo ta'u, waliigala namoota shanitu haleellaa kanaan du'e. Hawaasni naannichaa gadda isaa ibsateera.

title: Remains of Bulgaria’s Czar Samuel return ‘home’ after 1,000 years
english: The remains of the medieval Bulgarian ruler Czar Samuel have returned to Sofia over a millennium after his death. His repatriation follows a diplomatic agreement between Bulgaria and Greece, which also involves the return of Greek cultural artifacts taken during World War I. Thousands of citizens gathered to welcome the historic leader home, marking a symbolic step toward peace and cooperation between the two nations.
amharic: የመካከለኛው ዘመን የቡልጋሪያ ንጉሥ የዛር ሳሙኤል አጽም ከሞቱ ከአንድ ሺህ ዓመታት በኋላ ወደ ቡልጋሪያ ዋና ከተማ ሶፊያ ተመልሷል። ይህ የአጽም ልውውጥ የተፈጸመው በቡልጋሪያ እና በግሪክ መካከል በተደረገ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነት ሲሆን፣ ይህም አንደኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወቅት የተዘረፉ የግሪክ ቅርሶችን መመለስን ያካትታል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የቡልጋሪያ ዜጎች ታሪካዊውን መሪ በመቀበል በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የሰላም እና የመግባባት ተምሳሌታዊ ሂደት አክብረዋል።
oromo: Hafuurri mootii Bulgaariyaa durii Zaar Saamu'eel du'a isaa booda waggaa kuma tokko ol booda gara magaalaa guddoo Sofiyaatti deebi'eera. Deebiin kun kan ta'e waliigaltee dippilomaasii Bulgaariyaa fi Giriik gidduutti godhame yoo ta'u, kunis yaadannoo fi meeshaalee aadaa Giriik waraana addunyaa tokkoffaa irratti fudhataman deebisuu kan dabalatuudha. Lammiileen Bulgaariyaa kumaan lakkaa'aman hogganaa seenaa kanaa simachuun, hariiroo nagaa fi waliin hojjechuuf biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhame kana kabajaniiru.

title: Al Jazeera speaks to Palestinian schoolboy from viral photograph
english: A Palestinian student who appeared in a viral photograph has spoken out about his traumatic experience after being captured and beaten by Israeli soldiers in the West Bank. The boy was simply trying to return home from school when he was discovered and assaulted by the military. Due to the lingering fear caused by this violent encounter, he is now terrified to go back to his classes.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ተይዞ የተደበደበውና በፎቶግራፍ አማካኝነት በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ሲሰራጭ የነበረው ፍልስጤማዊ ተማሪ፣ ስለደረሰበት አስከፊ አደጋ ተናገረ። ልጁ ከትምህርት ቤት ወደ ቤቱ እየተመለሰ ሳለ ነበር በወታደሮቹ የተገኘውና ጥቃት የተፈጸመበት። በዚህ ድርጊት ባሳደረው ከፍተኛ ስጋት የተነሳ ተማሪው አሁን ትምህርት ቤት ለመመለስ እየፈራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Barataan Falastinii tokko kan suuraan isaa miidiyaalee irratti babal'ate, yeroo gara manaatti deebi'aa turetti waraana Israa'eliin qabamee akka reebame ibseera. Mucaan kun yeroo mana barumsaatii gara manaatti deebi'aa turetti waraanan argamee reebichi irratti raawwatame. Mudannoo kana booda sodaa keessa kan gale mucaan kun, amma gara mana barumsaa deebi'uuf baay'ee sodaachaa jira.

title: England trounce Croatia 7-0 in Nations League as Kane goal run continues
english: England secured a dominant 7-0 victory over Croatia in their Nations League match held in Rijeka. Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka each scored twice, while Jude Bellingham contributed three assists alongside a goal of his own. This convincing win, which also featured goals from Anthony Gordon and Morgan Rogers, puts England in a strong position to qualify for the tournament's quarterfinals.
amharic: እንግሊዝ በኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ክሮኤሽያን 7 ለ 0 በሆነ ሰፊ ውጤት አሸንፋለች። ሃሪ ኬን እና ቡካዮ ሳካ እያንዳንዳቸው ሁለት ግቦችን ሲያስቆጥሩ፣ ጁድ ቤሊንግሃም ሶስት ለግብ የሚሆኑ ኳሶችን በማመቻቸት እና አንድ ግብ በማስቆጠር ከፍተኛ አስተዋጽኦ አድርገዋል። አንቶኒ ጎርደን እና ሞርጋን ሮጀርስም የግብ ድርሻቸውን የተወጡበት ይህ ድል፣ እንግሊዝ ወደ ውድድሩ የሩብ ፍጻሜ ለመግባት ያላትን እድል በእጅጉ ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Ingiliz tapha Nations League ta'e irratti Kroeeshiyaa 7-0 kutaatii injifatteerti. Haarii Keeyn fi Bukaayoo Saakaa taphataan lamaan kun gola lama lama kan lakkoofsise yoo ta'u, Juud Beelinghaam ammoo gola tokko lakkoofsisee gola sadii mijeesseera. Injifannoon guddaan kun taphattoota biroo, kanneen akka Antoonii Goordanii fi Moorgaan Roojars kan irratti hirmaatan, Ingiliz gara matachuumaa itti aanuutti darbuuf carraa gaarii akka qabaattu taasiseera.

title: Portugal vs Norway: UEFA Nations League – Ronaldo latest, Haaland, teams
english: Portugal is preparing to host Norway in an upcoming UEFA Nations League match at the Estadio do Dragao. The game is highly anticipated following the sudden departure of Cristiano Ronaldo from the Portuguese squad amid reports of tension with coach Jorge Jesus. While Portugal aims to defend their title, Norway will look to challenge them with the attacking power of Erling Haaland.
amharic: ፖርቹጋል በኤስታዲዮ ዶ ድራጋኦ ለሚደረገው የዩኢኤፍኤ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ከኖርዌይ ጋር ለመግጠም እየተዘጋጀች ነው። ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ በአሰልጣኝ ጆርጅ ጄሱስ ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ምክንያት ቡድኑን ለቅቆ መውጣቱ ለጨዋታው ከፍተኛ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል። ፖርቹጋል የውድድሩን ዋንጫ ለመከላከል ስትጥር፣ ኖርዌይ ደግሞ በኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ መሪነት ጠንካራ ተጋጣሚ እንደምትሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Portugal taphicha UEFA Nations League tahaa jiruuf, dirree Estadio do Dragao irratti Norway simachuuf qophaa'aa jirti. Cristiano Ronaldo leenjisaa Jorge Jesus waliin wal dhabuun isaa kan irraa kan ka'e garee biyyattii gadhiisee bahuun isaa oduu guddaa ta'eera. Portugal qophii isaanii kan itti fufan yoo ta'u, Norway ammoo qindoomina Erling Haaland fayyadamuun injifannoo argachuuf halkanii guyyaa hojjataa jirti.

title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution, governor says
english: Tennessee's prison commissioner, Frank Strada, is resigning following a botched execution attempt of death row inmate Christa Pike. Pike survived two lethal injection procedures and is currently hospitalized in critical condition. Governor Bill Lee confirmed the resignation, as an official investigation into the failed execution process continues.
amharic: የቴነሲ ግዛት የእስር ቤቶች አስተዳደር ኮሚሽነር ፍራንክ ስትራዳ፣ ክሪስታ ፓይክ በተባለች እስረኛ ላይ የተፈጸመው የግድያ ሙከራ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ፓይክ ሁለት ጊዜ የተወጋችው ገዳይ መርፌ ሳይገድላት በመቅረቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሆስፒታል በፅኑ ህክምና ላይ ትገኛለች። የክልሉ ገዢ ቢል ሊ የኮሚሽነሩን መልቀቅ ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በጉዳዩ ላይ የተጀመረው ምርመራም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hogganaan mana sirreessaa kan mootummaa Tennessee, Frank Strada, yaaliin ajjeechaa hidhamaa Christa Pike irratti taasifame fashaluusaa hordofee aangoosaa gadhiisuuf murteesseera. Pike dugdaan du’aatti murtaa’ee kan ture yoo ta’u, saniifiin ajjeechaa ishee irratti fudhatame waan hin milkoofneef amma yaala yaalchiisaa jiru keessatti argamti. Bulchaan naannichaa Bill Lee gadi ba’uu hogganichaa kan mirkaneessan yoo ta’u, qorannoon sababa rakkoo kanaa adda baasuuf gaggeeffamu itti fufa.

title: What we know about the co-pilot accused in Flydubai attack
english: A Flydubai co-pilot, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, has been accused of carrying out a terrorist attack against the flight's captain. Reports indicate that al-Hammami had a history of being grounded by aviation authorities due to concerns regarding his extremist beliefs. The incident has raised serious questions about aviation security and personnel vetting protocols.
amharic: የፍላይዱባይ አብራሪ ረዳት የሆነው ኦማናዊው ሃማም አል-ሃማሚ፣ በአውሮፕላኑ ካፒቴን ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ ተከሷል። ግለሰቡ ቀደም ሲል በአክራሪ አመለካከቶች ምክንያት በበረራ እንዳይሳተፍ ተከልክሎ እንደነበር ተዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በአቪዬሽን ደህንነት እና በሰራተኞች ቅጥር ሂደት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Gargaaraan phaylootii xiyyara Flydubai lammii Omaan kan ta’e Hamam al-Hammami, kabiteenii xiyyarichaa irratti haleellaa shororkeessummaa raawwateera jedhamee himatameera. Gabaasoonni akka agarsiisanitti, al-Hammami yaada qarqaraa qabaachuu isaatiin walqabatee kanaan dura akka inni hin barrisne dhowwamee ture. Gochi kun nageenya xiyyarootaa fi qulqulleeffannaa hojjettootaa irratti gaaffii guddaa kaaseera.

title: ‘Bordering on angry’: The state of play as US midterms enter final month
english: As the US midterm elections enter their final month, Democrats are showing unexpected momentum in their bid to win control of the House of Representatives. President Donald Trump is facing record-low approval ratings as voters express deep frustration over economic issues and rising costs linked to the US-Israel conflict with Iran. In response, Republicans are shifting significant campaign funds to defend seats they previously considered safe.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ወደ ፍጻሜው እየተቃረበ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት፣ ዲሞክራቶች የአሜሪካን የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ለመቆጣጠር ያላቸው ዕድል እየሰፋ መጥቷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል እና ኢራን ግጭት ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው የዋጋ ንረት የተበሳጩ መራጮች በመኖራቸው የድጋፍ መጠናቸው ወደ ታች ወርዷል። ሪፐብሊካኖችም ቀደም ሲል በቀላሉ ያሸንፋሉ ብለው የገመቷቸውን መቀመጫዎች ለማስጠበቅ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filannoon giddu galeessa US gara xumuraatti yeroo itti dhiyaate kanatti, paartiin Dimookraatootaa mana maree bakka buutotaa to’achuuf abdii guddaa argachaa jiru. Prezidaant Doolard Traamp rakkoo diinagdee fi gatii boba’aa dabaluun walqabatee rakkoo biyyattiin keessa jirtuun kan ka’e, deggarsi isaaniis sadarkaa gadi aanaa irra ga’eera. Paartiin Rippabilikaanii ammoo, bakka kanaan dura salphaatti mo’atu jedhame eegamaa ture of harkaa qabuuf mallaqa guddaa baasanii duula filannoo isaanii jabeeffachaa jiru.

title: Tens of thousands protest in Spain after failed housing reforms
english: Tens of thousands protest in Spain after failed housing reforms

title: At least 17 people, mostly pilgrims, killed in Kenya road crash
english: A tragic multi-vehicle collision in Kenya’s Salama region has resulted in the deaths of at least 17 people, primarily Catholic pilgrims traveling to a prayer site. The accident occurred when a truck attempted an unsafe overtake, leading to a crash with a minibus carrying the victims. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which took place on a stretch of road frequently identified as a dangerous accident hotspot.
amharic: በኬንያ ሳላማ አካባቢ በተከሰተ አስከፊ የተሽከርካሪ ግጭት ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አብዛኞቹም ወደ ጸሎት ቦታ ሲጓዙ የነበሩ የካቶሊክ ምዕመናን ናቸው። አደጋው የደረሰው አንድ የጭነት መኪና አሽከርካሪ የሌላ ተሽከርካሪን ለመቅደም ሲሞክር ተቆጣጥሮት በመውደቁ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ ቦታው በተደጋጋሚ አደጋዎች በሚከሰቱባቸው መንገዶች መካከል የሚጠቀስ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Keeniyaatti balaa konkolaataa hammaataa naannoo Salaamaatti mudateen namoonni 17 ol du'aniiru; isaan keessaa baay'een isaanii gara bakka kadhataatti imalaa kan turan amantoota Katoolikii turan. Balaan kun kan mudate erga konkolaataan fe'umsaa tokko karaa dogoggora ta'een konkolaataa biroo bira darbuuf yaalee booda konkolaataa namoota kana fe'e wajjin walitti bu'anii dha. Aangeyyoonni balaa kana irratti qorannoo eegalanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, iddoon kun bakka balaan konkolaataa itti heddummatu ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: What to know about Brazil’s 2026 presidential election
english: Brazil is preparing for a highly contested presidential election on October 4, featuring a close race between the incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his right-wing opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro. The political climate remains tense following the imprisonment of former leader Jair Bolsonaro for his involvement in a failed coup plot. Voters are primarily focused on the nation's economic struggles and rising crime rates as the country navigates this pivotal moment in its democracy.
amharic: ብራዚል በጥቅምት 4 ቀን በሚካሄደው የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ፣ አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና የቀኝ ዘመም ተቃዋሚው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ መካከል ከፍተኛ ፉክክር እየተጠበቀ ነው። የቀድሞው መሪ ጃኢር ቦልሶናሮ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ለመሞከር በመታሰራቸው የሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል። መራጮች በተለይም በሀገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና የወንጀል ስጋቶች በዋናነት እየተመለከቱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Brazil qophii filannoo pirezidaantummaa kan Onkoloolessa 4 gaggeeffamuuf jiru keessa jirti; filannichis giddu galeessa pirezidaantii ammaa Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa fi mormituu mirgaa Flaaviwoo Bolsoonaaroo gidduutti wal dorgommii cimaan akka jiraatu dubbatamaa jira. Hogganaan duraanii Jaayir Bolsoonaaroo yaalii fonqolcha mootummaan hidhamuun isaanii haala siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa uumee jira. Lammiileen biyyattii rakkoo dinagdee fi dabalata yakkaatiif xiyyeeffannoo guddaa kennuun filannicha hordofaa jiru.

title: Report: Israeli attempt to kill senior Hamas official fails
english: The Israeli military recently carried out an unsuccessful operation aimed at killing Ali al-Amoudi, a high-ranking Hamas official in Gaza. Reports indicate that al-Amoudi has been acting as the primary leader in the region, effectively filling the role previously held by Yahya Sinwar. Despite the effort, the targeted individual managed to survive the attack.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በጋዛ የሚገኘውን ከፍተኛ የሀማስ ባለስልጣን አሊ አል-አሙዲን ለመግደል ያደረገው ሙከራ ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። እንደ ዘገባዎቹ ከሆነ፣ አል-አሙዲ ቀደም ሲል በያህያ ሲንዋር ይያዝ የነበረውን ስልጣን በመረከብ በጋዛ የቡድኑን ዋና መሪ ሆነው እያገለገሉ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቱ ቢሰነዘርም ግለሰቡ በህይወት ተርፈዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el hogganaa olaanaa garee Hamaas kan Gaazaatti argamu Alii al-Amuudii ajjeesuuf yaaliin inni godhe milkaa'uu hin dandeenye. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, Amuudiin gahee Yahiyaa Sinwaar duraan qabachaa turan guutuun, ammaan tana hogganaa olaanaa ta'anii hojjachaa jiru. Yaalii ajjeechaa kana keessatti garuu, namichi kun lubbuun ooluu danda'eera.

title: Eight Palestinians, including mother and daughter, killed in attacks across Gaza since dawn
english: At least eight Palestinians have lost their lives in ongoing Israeli attacks across Gaza since this morning. Among the casualties was a mother and her daughter, who were killed when an apartment building was destroyed in Gaza City. Other victims included individuals who died from injuries sustained during previous strikes.
amharic: ከዛሬ ማለዳ ጀምሮ በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በጋዛ ከተማ አንድ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ሲመታ እናትና ሴት ልጇን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ሌሎች ተጎጂዎች ደግሞ ቀደም ብለው በደረሱባቸው ጉዳቶች ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሰዎች ናቸው።
oromo: Ganama har'aa irraa jalqabee weerara Israa'el ganda Gaaza keessatti gaggeessiteen palastinaanonni saddeet ol ta'an lubbuun darbaniiru. Magaala Gaaza keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatameen haadha fi intalli ishee lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, namoonni biroos madaa duraan irra gaheen du'aniiru.

title: Israeli attack injures several Palestinians in Gaza
english: Several Palestinians were wounded in a drone strike carried out by Israeli forces in Gaza City on Friday evening. The attack took place near a local school, resulting in multiple casualties including some individuals in critical condition. Victims were promptly transported to a nearby medical facility for urgent treatment.
amharic: አርብ ምሽት በጋዛ ከተማ በእስራኤል ድሮን በተፈጸመ ጥቃት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በአንድ ትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከልም አንዳንዶቹ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ተገልጿል። የተጎዱት ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ ወደ ህክምና ተቋማት ተወስደው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) Israa'el raawwattee kanaan namoonni biyyoolessaa Filisxeem hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun mana barnootaa tokko biratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, miidhaa cimaa irra ga'een lubbuun namoota tokko tokkoo balaa keessa galeera. Namoonni miidhaman kun yeroo ammaa hospitaala galanii yaalamaa jiru.

title: Yemeni army claims 1,540 Houthi casualties as fighting intensifies in Taiz
english: The Yemeni military reported that over 1,500 Houthi fighters were killed or injured following intense clashes over the last 24 hours, primarily in the Taiz region. Government forces launched nearly 500 targeted attacks using aircraft, drones, and heavy artillery to strike rebel command centers and military assets. This surge in fighting marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict as government troops push to reclaim various parts of the province.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት ጦር ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ ውጊያ ከ1,500 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። የመንግሥት ጦር በአውሮፕላኖች፣ በድሮኖች እና በከባድ መሳሪያዎች በመታገዝ በታኢዝ ግዛት በሚገኙ የሁቲዎች ዋና መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከላትና ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ ከ470 በላይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽሟል። ይህ የአካባቢው ግጭት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን የመንግሥት ኃይሎችም በተለያዩ የጠቅላይ ግዛቷ አካባቢዎች እንቅስቃሴያቸውን አጠናክረዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti waraana naannoo Ta'izitti geggeeffameen loltoonni Huutii 1,540 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu ykn madaa'uu ibseera. Waraanni mootummaa xiyyaarota, diroonotaa fi meeshaalee waraanaa gurguddaa fayyadamuun bakkeewwan Huutiin itti guddatan irratti duula 474 ol gaggeesseera. Waraanni kun daangaa biyyattii keessatti waldhabdee uumame hammaachuu isaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, loltoonni mootummaa naannoo sana guututti to'annaa isaanii jala galchuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Palestinian man succumbs to wounds sustained from Israeli attack in Deir el-Balah
english: A Palestinian man named Mohammad Talat Aqel has passed away following a head injury caused by Israeli gunfire. He had been receiving medical care at Al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir el-Balah for several days before succumbing to his wounds. The incident occurred in the Umm Dhuhair area located in central Gaza.
amharic: ሞሃመድ ታላት አቀል የተባሉ ፍልስጤማዊ በዴይር ኤል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት በደረሰባቸው የጭንቅላት ጉዳት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ለበርካታ ቀናት በአል-አቅሳ ሆስፒታል ህክምና ሲደረግላቸው የቆዩ ቢሆንም በደረሰባቸው ከባድ ጉዳት ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ሊተርፍ አልቻለም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው በጋዛ ማዕከላዊ ክፍል በኡም ዱሃይር አካባቢ ነው።
oromo: Namni Falasxiinii Mohammad Talat Aqel jedhamu, haleellaa waraana Israa'el naannoo Deir el-Balahitti isarratti raawwatameen mataasaatti miidhaa cimaa irra ga'ee ture. Guyyoota muraasaaf Hospitaala Al-Aqsa keessatti yaalamaa kan ture yoo ta'u, miidhicha dandamachuu dadhabee lubbuun isaa darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame naannoo Umm Dhuhair, giddugaleessa Gaazaa keessatti.

title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
english: A Flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with a cockpit axe while the plane was flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The aircraft dropped 17,000 feet before passengers and crew managed to subdue the attacker and land the plane safely in Saudi Arabia. UAE authorities are currently investigating the incident to determine if the motive was linked to terrorism or radicalization.
amharic: አንድ የፍላይዱባይ ረዳት አብራሪ ከዱባይ ወደ ቴል አቪቭ በመብረር ላይ በነበረ አውሮፕላን ውስጥ ካፒቴኑን በመጥረቢያ አጥቅቷል። አውሮፕላኑ 17,000 ጫማ ወደ ታች ከተንሸራተተ በኋላ ተሳፋሪዎች እና የበረራ ሰራተኞች አጥቂውን በመቆጣጠር አውሮፕላኑን በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሰላም ማሳረፍ ችለዋል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱ ከሽብርተኝነት ወይም ከጽንፈኝነት ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gargaaraan balaliisaa xiyyaara Flydubai tokko imala Dubai irraa gara Tel Aviv adeemaa ture keessatti kabitanii isaa qottoon haleelee jira. Xiyyaarichi miila 17,000 gadi bu'ee erga raafamee booda, imaltoonni fi hojjettoonni xiyyaarichaa haleelticha to'annoo jala oolchanii xiyyaaricha biyya Sa'ud Arabiyaatti nagaan buusuu danda'aniiru. Bulchiinsi biyya UAE qorannoo jalqabeen gochi kun shororkeessummaa ykn yaada qaxaleessummaa wajjin walqabatuu isaa adda baasuuf yaalii gochaa jira.

title: Protesters across Spain demand action over housing crisis
english: Thousands of people across Spain are protesting to demand better housing protections after the government failed to pass emergency legislation. The unrest was sparked by the eviction of an elderly woman, leading to widespread calls for lower rents and stricter rules on property investments. This legislative defeat has weakened Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s government and created uncertainty about the potential for early national elections.
amharic: በስፔን መንግስት ድንገተኛ የመኖሪያ ቤት ህግን ማሳለፍ ባለመቻሉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች የተሻለ የቤት ተከራይ መብቶችን በመጠየቅ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የአንድ አረጋዊት ሴት ከቤት መፈናቀል ያስከተለው ቁጣ ህዝቡ የቤት ኪራይ እንዲቀንስ እና በሪል እስቴት ኢንቨስትመንቶች ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ እንዲጠይቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ የፓርላማ ሽንፈት የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝን መንግስት የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ብሎ ምርጫ ሊደረግ ይችላል የሚል ስጋትም ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan ispain seera ariifachiisaa mana jireenyaa dabarsuu dadhabuu isaa hordofee, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman mirga gurguddaa qabaachuu gaafachuun hiriira bahaniiru. Ari'iinsi dubartii manguddoo tokkoo aariin uummataa akka dabalu taasisun, kireen manaa akka hir'atu fi invastimantiin lafaa fi mana jireenyaa irratti seerri cimaan akka ba'u gaafataniiru. Injifatannoon paarlaamaa kun mootummaa muummicha ministeeraa Pedro Sanchez irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, filannoon biyyoolessaa yeroodhaan dursee geggeeffamuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama jira.

title: World No 1 Sinner withdraws from Shanghai Masters as knee injury lingers
english: World number one tennis player Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the upcoming Shanghai Masters due to an ongoing knee injury. The Italian athlete has been unable to compete since his victory at Wimbledon in July, forcing him to miss several major tournaments including the US Open. His absence in Shanghai provides an opportunity for Alexander Zverev to challenge for the top world ranking.
amharic: የዓለም የቴኒስ ደረጃ አንደኛ የሆነው ጃኒክ ሲነር በጉልበት ጉዳት ምክንያት በመጪው የሻንጋይ ማስተርስ ውድድር ላይ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቋል። ጣሊያናዊው ተጫዋች ከሐምሌ ወር የዊምብልደን ድሉ ወዲህ ባጋጠመው ጉዳት ምክንያት የዩኤስ ኦፕንን ጨምሮ በርካታ ውድድሮችን አምልጦታል። የእሱ መቅረት ለዓለም ደረጃ አንደኛነት እየተፎካከረ ለሚገኘው አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ ጥሩ አጋጣሚን ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Taphataan tenisiin addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu Jannik Sinner, miidhama jilbaa isaa kanaan wal-qabatee dorgommii Shanghai Masters dhufu irratti akka hin hirmaanne beeksiseera. Atileetichi lammii Xaaliyaanii kun injifannoo Wiimbaldan Caamsaa darbe booda miidhamuu isaatiin wal-qabatee, dorgommiwwan gurguddoo hedduu dabalatee US Open irraa hafeera. Hin hirmaannaan isaa kun, atileetii Alexander Zverev jedhamuuf sadarkaa addunyaa tokkoffaa qabachuuf carraa guddaa banaafii jira.

title: The double standards of a failed execution
english: The U.S. state of Tennessee recently failed to execute Christa Pike, a 50-year-old woman with a history of severe trauma and mental illness, after a botched lethal injection attempt. The author argues that this situation highlights a global double standard, as similar human rights failures in countries like Iran would face widespread international condemnation. Pike, who committed her crime as a teenager, survived the attempt and is now suffering from its physical effects, reigniting concerns about the cruelty and ethics of the death penalty.

title: Ethiopia’s government forces retake airport from Tigray rebels in Mekelle
english: Ethiopian government forces have regained control of the Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle, following a recent retreat by Tigrayan rebel fighters. Local reports indicate that the rebels are leaving the city, raising concerns among residents about a potential security vacuum and looting. The federal military is currently conducting a counteroffensive to reclaim territories that were seized by a coalition of rebel groups last month.

Waraanni federaalaa ji'a darbe gareewwan finxaaleyyiin qabaman deebisanii qabachuuf duula geggeessaa jiru.

title: Palestinians gather for football amid Gaza’s ruins
english: Displaced Palestinians in Khan Younis recently organized a friendly football match to find a brief moment of normalcy amidst the ongoing conflict. They played the game on a makeshift field surrounded by destroyed buildings and tents housing those uprooted by the war. This event highlights the resilience of the local community as they attempt to maintain daily life despite the constant threat of Israeli military operations.

title: How AI is helping Mexico detect breast cancer earlier
english: Mexico is utilizing artificial intelligence to address the shortage of medical specialists and reduce lengthy wait times for breast cancer screenings. The technology works by identifying potentially dangerous scans, which are then analyzed by doctors who work from remote locations. This initiative aims to improve early detection rates for patients across the country.

title: 'The entire land is ours': Ben Gvir escalates calls for annexation of occupied West Bank
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has publicly declared that the entire West Bank belongs to Israel. He stated that if he becomes defense minister, he intends to dissolve the Palestinian Authority and encourage the displacement of Palestinians from the region. These remarks challenge the existing Oslo Accords, which designate specific territories for Palestinian governance.

title: Gaza death toll rises after seven Palestinians killed in 24 hours
english: The Gaza health ministry reports that seven more Palestinians have been killed by Israeli strikes over the past day, bringing the total death toll to 74,229. Recent casualties include people rescued from rubble and those who died from earlier injuries. Additionally, thousands recently attended a mass funeral for over 100 victims whose bodies were recovered from a building destroyed early in the conflict.

Namoota guyyoota darban keessa du'an keessaa muraasni isaanii diigamuu manaa jala kan baafaman yoo ta'u, kaan immoo madaa kanaan dura irra gaheen kan du'anidha. title: Reports of 'massive, successive and powerful' explosions in southern Lebanese town
english: Multiple strong explosions were reported in the southern Lebanese town of Mansouri. According to local media, these powerful blasts were carried out by Israeli forces. The incident highlights ongoing military tensions in the region.

title: Watch: Ben-Gvir says Israel would sell Palestinians to other countries
english: Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has suggested that Israel should pay other nations to accept Palestinian people as a way to remove them from the region. During a recent television interview, he proposed using financial incentives to facilitate this relocation. His comments have sparked significant controversy regarding his stance on the Palestinian population.

title: 'The entire land is ours': Ben Gvir escalates calls for annexation of occupied West Bank
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has publicly declared his intent to annex the entire West Bank and dismantle the Palestinian Authority if he becomes defense minister. He is advocating for policies that would encourage the displacement of Palestinians and provide soldiers with greater authority to use force. These remarks, made ahead of the upcoming Knesset elections, highlight his extreme political stance regarding Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ከሆኑ ሙሉውን የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ለመቀላቀል እና የፍልስጤም አስተዳደርን ለማፍረስ እቅድ እንዳላቸው በይፋ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ፍልስጤማውያን ከቀያቸው እንዲለቁ የሚያበረታቱ ፖሊሲዎችን ለመተግበር እና ወታደሮች የኃይል እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ያላቸውን ነፃነት ለማስፋት ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ንግግሮች የተሰሙት በአስራኤል የፓርላማ ምርጫ ዋዜማ ሲሆን የአቋማቸውን አክራሪነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministeerri Nageenya Biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gvir, yoo ministeera ittisa biyyaa ta'an guutummaa daangaa Weest Baank qabachuufi qaama bulchiinsa Falasxeem diiguuf karoora akka qaban ifatti dubbataniiru. Kana malees, Falasxeemonni lafa isaanii akka gadi lisan jajjabeessuufi loltoonni humna waraanaa akka fayyadaman mirga bal'aa akka argatan gaafataniiru. Yaanni kun kan ibsame filannoo Israa'el dhihaatu ilaalchisee yoo ta'u, ejjennoo siyaasaa isaan cimaa ta'e agarsiisa.

title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
english: Russian forces have struck a second major bridge in Kyiv, causing damage to the road and power infrastructure. Mayor Vitali Klitschko noted that these attacks on critical transit routes between the eastern and western parts of the city signal an escalation in Moscow's strategy. Emergency crews are currently managing the situation, which has led to significant traffic disruptions and heightened security concerns across the capital.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ ከተማ ሁለተኛውን ትልቅ ድልድይ በመምታት በመንገድ እና በኤሌክትሪክ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የከተማዋ ከንቲባ ቪታሊ ክሊችኮ እንዳሉት እነዚህ በከተማዋ ምስራቃዊ እና ምዕራባዊ ክፍሎች መካከል ባሉ ወሳኝ መተላለፊያዎች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች የሞስኮ የጦርነት ስትራቴጂ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በስፍራው ተገኝተው ጉዳቱን ለማስተካከል እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ በትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እና የጸጥታ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa gamoo riqicha guddaa lammaffaa magaalaa Kiyiv keessatti argamu haleeluun miidhaa karaa fi bu’uuraaleealee misoomaa irratti geessisaniiru. Kantiibaan magaalattii Vitali Klichko akka ibsanitti, riqichota kana haleeluu jechuun tarsiimoon waraanaa Moskoo daran hammaataa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa haala sana to’achuuf hojjechaa jiran yoo ta’u, haleellaan kun imala konkolaataa fi nageenya magaalattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Singer Zach Bryan wears Free Palestine shirt at Gillette Stadium
english: Country music artist Zach Bryan recently wore a t-shirt supporting Palestine during his concert at Gillette Stadium. This stadium is owned by Robert Kraft, a billionaire known for his strong support of Israel. The incident is notable because Kraft previously blocked another musician, Macklemore, from performing at the venue due to his pro-Palestine views.
amharic: የሀገር ሙዚቃ ዘፋኙ ዛክ ብራያን በጊሌት ስታዲየም ባደረገው ኮንሰርት ላይ ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ ቲሸርት ለብሶ ታይቷል። ይህ ስታዲየም የእስራኤል ደጋፊ በሆኑት ቢሊየነር ሮበርት ክራፍት ባለቤትነት ስር ያለ ነው። ክራፍት ከዚህ ቀደም ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ አቋም የነበረውን ዘፋኝ ማክለሞር በስታዲየማቸው እንዳይዘፍን መከልከላቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Artistii muuziqaa biyyaalessaa kan ta'e Zaak Biraayaan, oobdii Jileet Steediyeem keessatti sirba isaa irratti uffata Falaastiiniif deeggarsa agarsiisu uffatee ture. Steediyeemni kun kan qabamee fi to'atamu biiliyooneera Roobart Kiraafti kan Israa'eliif deeggarsa guddaa qabuun dha. Kiraafti kanaan dura muuziqeessaa biroo Maaklemoor jedhamu yaada isaa kan Falaastiinii deeggaru waan ibseef, akka achitti hin sirbine dhorkachuun isaa ni yaadatama.

title: ‘Trauma still there’: A decades-old standoff returns to Northern Ireland
english: Tensions have resurfaced in Portadown, Northern Ireland, as long-standing disputes over traditional Orange Order marches return to the Garvaghy Road. Residents still carry the heavy trauma from the 1990s, when conflicts between marchers and the local community often turned violent. The memory of the 1999 assassination of lawyer Rosemary Nelson, who advocated for the residents, remains a painful reminder of the region's unfinished history.
amharic: በሰሜን አየርላንድ ፖርታዳውን ከተማ፣ የኦሬንጅ ኦርደር ሰልፎች በሚያደርጉት የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት የቆየ የጥላቻ ትዝታ እንደገና አገረሸ። ነዋሪዎቹ በ1990ዎቹ ውስጥ በሰልፈኞችና በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ መካከል ተፈጥሮ የነበረውን ግጭት እና በወቅቱ የተፈጠረውን ከፍተኛ ቀውስ አሁንም በህመም ያስታውሳሉ። የነዋሪዎቹን መብት በመከራከር ትታወቅ የነበረችው ጠበቃ ሮዝመሪ ኔልሰን በ1999 መገደሏ፣ የክልሉን የፈውስ ሂደት አሁንም ያልተቋጨ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ህመም ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Portadawn kan Kaaba Aayerlaandi, walitti bu’iinsi durii duula 'Orange Order' jedhamuun walqabatee ture deebi’ee ka’eera. Jiraattoonni naannichaa yeroo ammaa kana yaada gadadoo fi miidhaa bara 1990 keessa turesi irraa argatan keessatti argamu. Akkaataan ajjeechaa abukaattoo Rosemary Nelson bara 1999 raawwatamee fi isheen namoota naannichaaf falmitu turte, seenaan naannichaa kan hin guutaminneefi miidhaan isaa ammallee akka jirutti akka jiru yaadachiisa.

title: India vs Pakistan live: Asian Games cricket final
english: In the men's cricket final at the Asian Games, India set a target of 212 runs for Pakistan to win the gold medal. Strong batting performances from Abhishek Sharma and Tilak Varma helped India reach a total of 211 runs for the loss of six wickets. Pakistan now needs to score 212 runs within their 20 overs to claim the championship title.
amharic: በእስያ ጨዋታዎች የወንዶች ክሪኬት ፍጻሜ ህንድ ለፓኪስታን የ212 ሩጫ ኢላማ በመጣል የወርቅ ሜዳሊያውን ለማሸነፍ ተፋልመዋል። በሁለቱ ተጫዋቾች በአቢሼክ ሻርማ እና ቲላክ ቫርማ ጥሩ ብቃት ህንድ በ20 ኦቨር 211 ሩጫዎችን ማስመዝገብ ችላለች። አሁን ፓኪስታን የወርቅ ሜዳሊያውን ለመውሰድ በተመደበው ጊዜ ውስጥ 212 ሩጫዎችን ማስቆጠር ይጠበቅባታል።
oromo: Tapha xumuraa kriketii dhiirota tapha Aasiyaa irratti, Hindii injifannoo argachuuf Paakistaaniif galii 212 saaxilteetti. Taphattoota Hindii kanneen akka Abishek Sharma fi Tilak Varma qabxii gaarii galchuun, Hindii ooverii 20 keessatti galii 211 galchuun injifannoo guddaa argatteetti. Amma Paakistaan medaalii warqee fudhachuuf ooverii 20 keessatti galii 212 galchuun ishee irraa eegama.

title: Flydubai co-pilot stabbed captain with crash axe in ‘terrorist’ attack: UAE
english: A Flydubai co-pilot is being investigated for a terrorist act after attacking the captain with an emergency axe during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The suspect attempted to seize control of the aircraft, causing it to drop significantly in altitude before other crew members regained stability. The flight, carrying 174 passengers, successfully conducted an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, and authorities are currently probing the motive behind the assault.
amharic: የፍላይዱባይ ረዳት አብራሪ ከዱባይ ወደ ተል አቪቭ በረራ ላይ እያለ ዋናውን አብራሪ በአደጋ ጊዜ መቆራረጫ መጥረቢያ በማጥቃት የሽብር ድርጊት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ እየተመረመረ ይገኛል። ጥቃት አድራሹ አውሮፕላኑን ለመቆጣጠር በመሞከሩ አውሮፕላኑ ከፍተኛ ቁመት እንዲያጣ አድርጓል፤ ሆኖም ሌሎች የበረራ ሰራተኞች አውሮፕላኑን መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። 174 ተሳፋሪዎችን የያዘው አውሮፕላን በሳውዲ አረቢያ አስቸኳይ ማረፊያ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የህግ አካላትም የተፈጠረውን ክስተት ተነሳሽነት ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gargaaraan balaliisaa xiyyaara Flydubai tokko balalii Dubaayii gara Tel Aviv imala irra jirutti, kabajaan xiyyaarichaa kottee lubbuu oolchuun miidhuun yakka shororkeessummaa raawwachuu isaan qorannoon irratti gaggeeffamaa jira. Shakkamichi to'annoo xiyyaarichaa fudhachuuf yaaluun isaa xiyyaarichi dafee olka'umsa isaa akka gadi buusu taasisee ture, ta'us hojjettoonni biroo xiyyaaricha to'annoo isaanii jala galchuuf danda'aniiru. Xiyyaarichi namoota 174 fe'ee ture kun biyya Sa'ud Arabiyaatti dirqamaan lafa irra qubachuu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, aangotni dhimma kana irratti kaka'umsa isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Gaza voters want jobs and security as Palestinian elections approach
english: Palestinians in Gaza are preparing for their first national legislative elections in two decades, scheduled for November 2026. Voters like Ahmad Mohsen are primarily focused on addressing the enclave's 80 percent unemployment rate, severe lack of security, and the urgent need for reconstruction following extensive wartime destruction. Residents hope that these elections will produce leaders who can stabilize the economy and restore basic services for the war-battered population.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ከሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሚካሄደው ብሔራዊ የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት ምርጫ ላይ ለመሳተፍ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። እንደ አህመድ ሞህሰን ያሉ መራጮች በዋናነት ትኩረት ያደረጉት በክልሉ ላይ በደረሰው የጦርነት ውድመት፣ በ80 በመቶ የሥራ አጥነት መጠን እና በደህንነት እጦት ላይ ነው። የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች ይህ ምርጫ የኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋትን የሚፈጥሩ እና በጦርነቱ የተጎዱትን አገልግሎቶች የሚያሻሽሉ መሪዎችን እንደሚያመጣ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Uummanni Gaza waggoota digdamii oliif booda yeroo jalqabaaf filannoo biyyoolessaa gaggeessuuf qophaa'aa jira. Jiraattonni akka Ahmad Mohsen, xiyyeeffannoo isaanii kan godhatan rakkoo hojidhabdummaa dhibbeentaa 80 ga'e, dhabamuu nageenyaa fi balaa waraanaan ga'e suphuufi. Namoonni naannichaa filannoo kanaan gaggeessitoota dinagdee tasgabbeessanii fi tajaajila bu'uuraa deebisanii dhaabuu danda'an ni arganna jedhanii abdatu.

title: Cornell frat house rape accuser 'under siege' online, says lawyer
english: A woman who alleges she was raped at a Cornell University fraternity in 2024 is currently facing intense harassment from online users attempting to reveal her identity. Her lawyer states that she was too intoxicated to consent during the incident and is now struggling under the pressure of social media scrutiny. Due to public outcry and concerns over the original investigation, the New York Attorney General has taken over the case, and state officials are working to address legal barriers regarding cases involving substance use.

title: US and Australia suspend diplomatic operations in Brazil before election
english: The United States and Australia have temporarily suspended diplomatic and consular operations in Brazil due to unspecified security threats. Although Brazilian police conducted investigations into potential risks, they have not yet found concrete evidence or specific suspects. These closures occur just days before a significant national presidential election.

title: Iran war live: Fighting intensifies in Yemen, hundreds killed or injured
english: Violent clashes have escalated significantly in Yemen, resulting in over 1,500 Houthi fighter casualties within a single day. Meanwhile, the Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted three ballistic missiles directed at southern Saudi Arabia, though falling debris caused injuries. Additionally, the United States is pressing for stricter international sanctions on Iran while simultaneously targeting financial networks linked to Hamas.

title: Two Iranians charged over suspected plot to target Jews in Manchester
english: Two Iranian men have been charged in the UK for allegedly planning a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in Manchester. Authorities claim the suspects gathered materials to build an explosive device and scouted targets around the holy day of Yom Kippur. The UK government highlighted this case as part of a broader pattern of threats posed by the Iranian regime against Jewish people and critics abroad.

title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat
english: The G7 nations have collectively decided to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel to help lower global fuel costs and stabilize supply. This decision follows pressure from President Trump, who had warned about potential export bans to protect American consumers. As part of the agreement, member countries have pledged to avoid placing restrictions on energy exports to each other.
