title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
english: Death row inmate Christa Pike is in critical condition and on a ventilator after a botched lethal injection attempt in Tennessee. Lawyers reported that prison officials struggled to administer the drugs, using multiple needles and causing Pike significant distress during the failed process. In response to the incident, the state governor has ordered an investigation and suspended all further executions for the remainder of the year.
amharic: በቴነሲ ግዛት በሞት ቀጣ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ በተደረገላት የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸም ሙከራ ሳይሳካ በመቅረቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በጽኑ ህክምና እና በአተነፋፈስ መርጃ መሳሪያ ስር ትገኛለች። የህግ ባለሙያዎቿ እንደገለጹት፣ አስፈጻሚ አካላት መርፌውን በአግባቡ ለመወጋት በመቸገራቸው እስረኛዋ ከፍተኛ ህመም እና ስቃይ እንደደረሰባት ተናግረዋል። ይህን ተከትሎ የቴነሲ ግዛት አስተዳዳሪ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ በማዘዝ በግዛቱ ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸሞችን ለቀሪው አመት አግደዋል።
oromo: Magalaalchi Tennesseeitti namni ajjeechaaf itti murame Christa Pike, yeroo ajjeechaan sun itti raawwatamuu qabutti rakkoo mudateen booda amma hospitaala keessatti gargaarsa oksijiiniin jiratti. Abbootiin seeraa akka jedhanitti, namoonni ajjeechaa raawwachiisan sun iddoo gaarii maseelichaa argachuuf baay'ee dhiphatanii ture; kunis hidhamtuuttii sana irratti qaamaa fi sammuun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, bulchaan naannichaa qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu ajajeera; akkasumas hanga dhuma bara kanatti ajjeechaan biroo akka hin raawwatamne murteesseera.

title: Why Carney’s economic overhaul is clashing with Canada’s unions
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is pushing for legislative changes to accelerate infrastructure projects and strengthen the economy amid trade pressures from the United States. However, his new bill, which would grant the government more authority to intervene in labor disputes, is facing intense backlash from major unions. Labor leaders argue these measures unfairly restrict their right to strike and are prepared to defy the proposed regulations.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ከአሜሪካ ጋር በተፈጠረ የንግድ ውጥረት ምክንያት የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ ለማጠናከር እና ትላልቅ ፕሮጀክቶችን ለማፋጠን አዳዲስ ህጎችን በማውጣት ላይ ናቸው። ይሁን እንጂ መንግስት በሰራተኞች አድማ ላይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ስልጣን የሚሰጠው ይህ ረቂቅ ህግ በሰራተኛ ማህበራት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። የሰራተኛ ማህበራቱ ህጉ የአድማ መብታቸውን የሚጋፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ህጉ ከጸደቀም ህጉን ለመቃወም መዘጋጀታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii, dhiibbaa daldalaan Ameerikaarraa isaanirra ga'aa jiru dandamachuuf jecha, pirojektiiwwan gurguddoo saffisiisuufi dinagdee cimsuuf sirreeffama seeraa gochaa jiru. Ta'us, seeronni haaraan kun mootummaan hiriira mormii hojjettootaarratti akka gidduu galu aangoo waan kennaniif, gamtaawwan hojjettootaa gurguddoon mormaa jiru. Hojjettoonni kun mirga isaanii kan sarbu ta'uu eeruun, seeronni kun yoo ragga'anis falmachuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Croatia vs England: UEFA Nations League – Kane, Modric, teams, form
english: Croatia and England are set to face each other in a UEFA Nations League match this Saturday at the Rujevica Stadium in Croatia. Both teams have had identical starts in their group, each recording one win and one loss against Spain and the Czech Republic. The match highlights star players Harry Kane for England and the veteran Luka Modric, who continues to lead the Croatian midfield at age 41.
amharic: ክሮኤሽያ እና እንግሊዝ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በክሮኤሽያ ሩጄቪካ ስታዲየም በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ይፋለማሉ። ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በምድባቸው እስካሁን አንድ ድል እና አንድ ሽንፈትን በማስተናገድ ተመሳሳይ ውጤት አስመዝግበዋል። ጨዋታው የእንግሊዙን አጥቂ ሃሪ ኬን እና በ41 ዓመቱ የክሮኤሽያን አማካይ ክፍል በብቃት እየመራ የሚገኘውን ሉካ ሞድሪች የሚያገናኝ ይሆናል።
oromo: Kiroo'eeshiyaa fi Ingilaandi Dilbata dhufu tapha UEFA Nations League taphachuuf Rujevica Stadium irratti wal arguuf qophaa'aa jiru. Gareewwan lameenuu garee isaanii keessatti injifannoo tokkoo fi injifatamuu tokko galmeessisuun sadarkaa wal fakkaatu irra jiru. Taphichi kabajaa fi hogganaa Ingilaandi Haarii Keeyn fi umrii waggaa 41 keessatti garee Kiroo'eeshiyaa hogganaa jiru Luka Modriich gidduutti akka taasifamu eegama.

title: Police bodycam shows Luigi Mangione arrest at Pennsylvania McDonald’s
english: Newly released body camera footage captures the moment police arrested Luigi Mangione at a McDonald’s in Altoona, Pennsylvania. The incident, which took place on December 9, 2024, shows officers conducting a search of the suspect. During the apprehension, law enforcement officials discovered a firearm inside his backpack.
amharic: በአልቱና ፔንሲልቬኒያ በሚገኝ ማክዶናልድስ ውስጥ ፖሊስ ሉዊጂ ማንግዮንን ሲይዝ የሚያሳይ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስል ተለቋል። ታኅሣሥ 9 ቀን 2024 በተፈጸመው በዚህ ክስተት ወቅት ፖሊሶች ተጠርጣሪውን ሲፈትሹ ይታያሉ። በቁጥጥር ስር በዋሉበት ወቅትም በከረጢቱ ውስጥ ሽጉጥ መገኘቱ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Suur-sagaleen qaamaa irratti hidhatamu (bodycam) kan qabame, poolisoonni magaala Altoona, Pennsylvania keessatti argamu McDonald's tokko keessatti Luwii Maangiyoonii yommuu qaban kan agarsiisu gadi dhiifameera. Muddee 9, 2024 kan raawwatame gochi kun, poolisoonni shakkamaa kana yommuu sakatta'an kan agarsiisuudha. Yeroo qabamuu isaa kanattis, bagii isaa keessatti qawween argameera.

title: Israel could’ve ended Gaza war, freed captives sooner: Israel ex-negotiator
english: Former Israeli general Nitzan Alon stated that the war in Gaza could have ended and the captives returned much earlier if not for the government's prolonged approach. He described the Prime Minister's demand for total victory as misleading and noted that an earlier agreement would have saved many lives on both sides. Alon believes that the current strategic goals were achievable long before the actual October 2025 deal.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል ጄኔራል ኒትዛን አሎን እንደተናገሩት፣ የመንግስት የዘገየ አካሄድ ባይኖር ኖሮ በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ጦርነት ቀደም ብሎ ሊያበቃ እና ታጋቾችም ቀደም ብለው ሊለቀቁ ይችሉ ነበር። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ «ሙሉ ድል» እፈልጋለሁ የሚሉት አባባል አሳሳች እንደሆነ የገለጹት ጄኔራሉ፣ ቀደም ብሎ ስምምነት ላይ ቢደረስ ኖሮ በሁለቱም በኩል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህይወቶችን ማዳን ይቻል እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። አሎን አሁን የተደረሰው ስምምነት ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ሊሳካ የሚችል እንደነበር ያምናሉ።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el duraanii Nitzan Alon akka jedhanitti, mootummaan tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhatatee osoo ta'e, waraanni Gaazaa kanaan dura xumuramee fi namoonni butamanis yeroo dheeraa dura bilisa ba'uu danda'u turan. Mummichi ministeerichaa injifannoo guutuu argachuuf waan jedhuun soba fi yeroo gubuu qofa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Akka isaanii fi yaadannoo kanaatti, waliigaltee kanaan dura ta'ee ture osoo ta'e, jireenya namoota hedduu gama lamaanuu qusachuun danda'ama ture.

title: France held 1-1 by Italy in Zidane home debut after Olise stunner
english: France and Italy finished in a 1-1 draw during Zinedine Zidane's first home game as head coach at the Stade de France. Michael Olise gave the French side an early lead with a brilliant goal, but Alessandro Bastoni later equalized for the visitors. Despite the draw and a late red card for Dayot Upamecano, France remains at the top of their UEFA Nations League group.
amharic: ዚነዲን ዚዳን የፈረንሳይ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በስታድ ደ ፍራንስ ባደረጉት የመጀመሪያ የሜዳቸው ጨዋታ ፈረንሳይ እና ጣሊያን 1-1 በሆነ አቻ ውጤት ተለያይተዋል። ማይክል ኦሊሴ ግሩም ግብ በማስቆጠር ፈረንሳይን ቀዳሚ ቢያደርግም፣ አሌሳንድሮ ባስቶኒ ለጣሊያን አቻ ውጤቱን አስመዝግቧል። ዳዮት ኡፓሜካኖ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ ቢሰናበትም፣ ፈረንሳይ በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ የምድቧን መሪነት ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Zinediin Zidaan leenjisaa garee biyyoolessa Faransaay ta'anii erga muudamanii booda, tapha isaanii isa jalqabaa Faransaay fi Xaaliyaan 1-1 ta'uun xumurameera. Maaykil Olisee goolii ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'een Faransaay dursee akka geggeessitu godheus, Alesandro Baastooniin Xaaliyaaniif taphicha qixxeesseera. Daayoot Upaamekaanoon kaardii diimaa argatee taphichaa baatus, Faransaay hiriira UEFA Nations League irratti garee ishee durfachuu itti fufteetti.

title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
english: Thousands of students across France are protesting against poor school conditions, including overcrowded classrooms and a shortage of teachers. These demonstrations have escalated into violent clashes with riot police, resulting in fires, arrests, and injuries to both protesters and officers. The government is concerned about the growing public disorder as the protests continue to spread from Paris to cities across the nation.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ ያለው መጨናነቅ እና የመምህራን እጥረት ባለበት ሁኔታ ላይ በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ እያደረጉ ነው። ሰልፉ ወደ ሁከት ተቀይሮ ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት የተፈጠረ ሲሆን በተማሪዎች እና በፖሊስ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የፈረንሳይ መንግስት አመጹ ከፓሪስ ወደ ሌሎች ከተሞች በመስፋፋቱ እና የህዝብ ሰላምን በመረበሹ ስጋት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Barattoonni kumaan lakkaawaman Faransaay keessatti haala barnootaa gad aanaa fi hanqina barsiisotaa mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Hiriirri kun gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'iinsa uumee jira, kunis miidhaa namoota irratti geessiseera. Hiriirichi magaalaa Paarisii irraa gara magaaloota biroo biyyattii keessatti babal'achuun isaa mootummaa Faransaay yaaddoo keessa galchee jira.

title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
english: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has criticized the handling of a 2024 rape case at Cornell University, stating that authorities failed to support the victim throughout the process. The state Attorney General has been appointed to oversee a new investigation after the Governor lost confidence in local prosecutors. Additionally, the Governor aims to change laws to ensure that voluntarily using drugs or alcohol cannot be used as a defense for sexual assault.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ገዢ ካቲ ሆኩል በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተፈጸመውን የአስገድዶ መድፈር ክስ ባለስልጣናት በአግባቡ ባለመያዛቸው ተጎጂዋ ተገቢውን ድጋፍ አላገኘችም ብለዋል። በአካባቢው አቃቤ ህግ ላይ እምነት በማጣታቸው፣ ጉዳዩን በድጋሚ እንዲመረምሩ የኒውዮርክ ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ እንዲረከቡ ተደርጓል። በተጨማሪም ገዢው ሆኩል፣ አንድ ሰው በአልኮል ወይም በአደንዛዥ እጾች ምክንያት አቅመ ቢስ ከሆነ ይህ ለወንጀል ፈጻሚዎች ሰበብ ሊሆን አይገባም በማለት ህጉን ለማሻሻል አቅደዋል።
oromo: Gantootni mootummaa Niiw Yoorkii, kan akka Kaathee Hookul, qorannoo gudeeddii yunivarsitii Koorneel irratti gaggeeffame sirrii miti jechuun komataniiru. Gochi kun miidhamtuu sanaaf eegumsa gochuu irraa kan hafe, mootummaan kan ishee dagate ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru. Giddu galeessi bulchiinsa naannoo tokko irraan kan ka'e, qorannoon kun amantii waan dhabeef, qorannoo haaraan abbaa alangaa biyyattii tiin akka geggeeffamuuf ajajameera. Kana malees, abbaan aangoo kun dhimmicha irratti seericha fooyyessuuf kan karoorsan yoo ta'u, namni tokko alkoolii ykn dawaa fayyadame jechuun qofa gudeeddii raawwachuun akka seeraan itti gaafatamuu qaban dubbataniiru.

title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
english: Kyiv mayor Vitaliy Klitschko has warned that escalating Russian drone and missile attacks are severely damaging the city's critical infrastructure and threatening civilian survival. Recent strikes on a major bridge and internet data centers have caused significant transportation disruptions and communication outages throughout the capital. Officials believe these aggressive tactics are intended to incite fear and panic among the city's three million residents.

oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Kiyeev Vitaliy Klitschko, haleellaan rookeettii fi xiyyaara malee (drone) Raashiyaan gaggeessaa jirtu bu'uraalee misoomaa magaalamtii miidhuun jireenya lammiilee balaa irra buusa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru. Haleellaan daandii guddichaa fi iddoo tajaajila interneetii irratti raawwatame geejjibaa fi quunnamtii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera. Kaayyoon Raashiyaa haleellaa kanaan uummata miliyoona sadii ta'e kanatti naasuu fi soda uumuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez suffered a major political setback after Congress rejected his proposed housing reform measures. These government decrees were introduced following nationwide public outrage over the eviction of an elderly woman from her apartment in Madrid. The defeat highlights the weakness of Sánchez's minority government, leading to increased speculation that he may be forced to call an early general election.

oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Ispeen Pedro Saancheez seerota rakkoo mana jireenyaa furuuf dhiyeessan mana maree biyyattii keessatti waan hin fudhatamneef injifannoo siyaasaa guddaa isa mudateera. Seerri kun kan dhiyaate dubartii dulloomtuu tokko mana ishee irraa buqqifamuun biyyattii keessatti mormii guddaa erga kaasee booda ture. Kufatiin seerota kanaa mootummaan Saancheez deggarsa gahaa akka hin qabne kan mirkaneessu yoo ta'u, kunis filannoon hatattamaa akka gaggeeffamu dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Israeli barrier cuts off water to West Bank Palestinians before elections
english: Israeli forces have imposed a severe siege on the Bedouin community of Ras al-Ahmar in the West Bank by constructing a new military barrier. This blockade has cut off essential supplies like water, animal feed, and medical care, putting both residents and their 15,000 livestock at critical risk. Families are now forced to transport supplies secretly at night to avoid soldiers and settlers who are reportedly trying to displace them from their land.

oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhihaa kan ta'e Ras al-Ahmar keessatti dhoorkaa waraanaa haaraa ijaaruun gandoota sana iratti harka keessa galchanii jiru. Jiraattonni kunis waraanaa fi qubattoota irraa dhokachuuf jedhanii bishaan fi meeshaalee biroo halkan halkan gaangeedhaan fe'uuf dirqamanii jiru.

title: Israel’s Supreme Court overturns election panel ban on Arab parties
english: Israel's Supreme Court has overturned a decision by the Central Elections Committee to ban major Arab political parties from the upcoming national election. The court ruled that the disqualifications lacked sufficient legal justification, ensuring that Palestinian citizens of Israel remain represented in the vote. Additionally, Jewish lawmaker Ofer Cassif was reinstated to the ballot, though Balad party leader Sami Abu Shehadeh withdrew his candidacy following pressure from the court.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የማዕከላዊ ምርጫ ኮሚቴ ዋነኛ የአረብ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎችን ከምርጫ ለማግለል የወሰነውን ውሳኔ ሽሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የማግለል ውሳኔው በቂ ህጋዊ ምክንያት እንደሌለው በማመን የአረብ ተወላጆች በምርጫው እንዲሳተፉ ወስኗል። እንዲሁም የአይሁድ ተወላጁ የፓርላማ አባል ኦፈር ካሲፍ በምርጫው እንዲወዳደሩ ሲፈቀድላቸው የባላድ ፓርቲ መሪ ሳሚ አቡ ሸሃዴ ግን ከጫና የተነሳ ከምርጫው እራሳቸውን አግልለዋል።

Kana malees, miseensi paarlamaa Yihudii Ofer Kaasiif filannicha irratti akka hirmaatu kan heyyamame yoo ta'u, hogganaan paartii Baalaad Saamii Abuu Shehaade garuu dhiibbaa isa irratti godhame hordofee filannoo keessaa of baaseera.

title: ‘I want the truth’: NY governor appoints prosecutor in Cornell rape case
english: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed State Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor to re-examine a 2024 gang rape case at Cornell University. The governor took this action after criticizing local authorities for failing to properly interview the victim or thoroughly investigate the initial allegations. This move transfers control of the criminal case from the local district attorney to the state level to ensure a transparent and comprehensive search for the truth.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Who gets to run in Israel’s elections?
english: The Israeli Supreme Court has issued a ruling that is raising concerns among Palestinians in Israel regarding their representation in upcoming elections. Many are questioning whether they will be granted a fair and equal opportunity to participate in the democratic process. This judicial decision has sparked a significant debate about political inclusion and rights for the Palestinian minority within the state.

Murteen kun murni xiqqeenyaan kun mirga siyaasaa fi hirmaannaa isaanii irratti jijjiirama akkamii akka fidu irratti mormii guddaa uumee jira.

title: How the Banco Master scandal injected chaos into Brazil’s presidential race
english: Brazil's presidential election is facing significant uncertainty due to the massive Banco Master fraud scandal. The scheme involved a bank offering unsustainable high-yield returns and hiding assets, which has negatively impacted both leading candidates, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro. Consequently, voters are showing widespread disillusionment and low enthusiasm, as both politicians struggle with high rejection rates ahead of the upcoming vote.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ በባንኮ ማስተር የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ቅሌት ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ገብቷል። ይህ ባንክ ዘላቂነት የሌለው ከፍተኛ ትርፍ ቃል በመግባት እና ንብረቶቹን በድብቅ በማዘዋወር የሀገሪቱን የፖለቲካ መድረክ አወኩት። በሁለቱ ዋና ተፎካካሪዎች ላይ የደረሰው የቅሌቱ ተጽዕኖ በምርጫው ላይ የህዝብ ተስፋ መቁረጥን አስከትሎ ከፍተኛ መቃወሚያ እንዲገጥማቸው አድርጓል።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantii biyya Braazil malaammaltummaa baankii Maastar jedhamuun walqabatee rakkoo cimaa keessa galee jira. Kana irraa kan ka'e, uummanni filannoo kana irratti abdii kutachuu fi diddaa guddaa agarsiisaa jiru.

title: Houthis say Saudi forces launched 94 strikes in Yemen in 24 hours
english: Houthi officials reported that Saudi military forces conducted 94 airstrikes within their territories over the last 24 hours. The group claims these attacks are part of an ongoing escalation that has seen over 1,350 strikes since the recent resumption of civil war hostilities. These events mark a significant increase in the intense conflict between the Houthi movement and the Saudi-supported government.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳውዲ አረቢያ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ እነሱ በሚቆጣጠሩት አካባቢዎች ላይ 94 የአየር ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ እንደገለጸው፣ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነቱ እንደገና ከተቀሰቀሰ ወዲህ በድምሩ ከ1,350 በላይ ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁቲዎች እና በሳውዲ በሚደገፈው የየመን መንግስት መካከል ያለው ግጭት እያደገ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni Hootii akka ibsetti, waraanni Saudi Arabiyaa sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti naannoo isaan to'atan irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa 94 gaggeesseera. Kunis walitti bu'iinsa garee Hootii fi mootummaa Saudi irraa deggaramaa jiru gidduutti jiru hammaachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.
